title: Junior Engineering
company: RATILAL BHAGWANDAS CONSTRUCTION COMPANY P LTD
description:
**Company Description**
RATILAL BHAGWANDAS CONSTRUCTION COMPANY P LTD is a real estate and construction company headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India. The company operates from its office near Phugewadi Octroi Post on the Mumbai–Pune Road in Dapodi, serving clients across the region. It is involved in developing and managing real estate projects with a focus on quality and timely delivery. Team members work closely with clients, contractors, and suppliers to support the company’s growing portfolio of construction and real estate initiatives.

**Role Description**
The Technical Sales Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Pune City. The person in this role will engage with prospective and existing clients to understand their technical and commercial requirements, present suitable construction and real estate solutions, and prepare proposals, quotations, and technical documentation. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting site visits, providing technical clarifications, supporting the sales team during client meetings, and coordinating with engineering and project teams to ensure feasibility and accuracy of solutions. The role also involves responding to client inquiries, offering post-sale technical support, tracking opportunities in the sales pipeline, and contributing to sales forecasts and reports. Collaboration with internal stakeholders to improve offerings and customer experience will be a key part of the role.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Technical Sales and Sales Engineering skills to identify client needs, propose solutions, and close deals.
* Experience in Sales and account management, including lead generation, negotiation, and relationship building.
* Ability to provide Technical Support, including resolving technical queries and coordinating with engineering teams.
* Excellent Communication skills for interacting with clients, preparing presentations, and drafting clear proposals.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field.
* Background in real estate, infrastructure, or construction projects is highly beneficial.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail in technical and commercial documentation.
* Comfort working on-site and conducting regular client and site visits within Pune and surrounding areas.
* Proficiency in MS Office and basic project or CRM tools to manage data, reports, and client information.

title: Proposal Engineer
company: Agile Technology Solutions - Your Technology Partner
description:
**About the Role**

Job Description: Proposal Engineer (Water Treatment Plant) Location: Pune Experience: 2 to 20 years in proposal engineering in the water and wastewater business Department: Proposals / Pre-Sales, Water & Waste Solutions About the Role We are a leading provider of water and wastewater solutions, covering water treatment, sewage treatment, effluent treatment, desalination, and recycle and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) plants for industrial and commercial clients across India and overseas. We are looking for a Proposal Engineer to prepare technically sound and cost-competitive proposals for water treatment projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Prepare technical proposals and documents for submission to clients.
* Select the right treatment process and equipment from raw water quality and client requirements, covering clarification, filtration, UF, RO, DM plants and polishing units.
* Work out estimates and prepare costing for proposals.
* Prepare Basic Engineering Package documents and P&IDs.
* Read engineering drawings and documentation requirements with ease.
* Understand client requirements, coordinate with internal groups, and develop competitive proposals.
* Take part in techno-commercial discussions and finalisation with clients, consultants, EPCs and OEMs.
* Negotiate with vendors for bought-out items.

**Qualifications**

* Essential Qualification Bachelors degree in Engineering (Mechanical / Chemical) from a reputed institution, with a good academic record throughout.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on proposal experience with DM plants, RO plants and polishing units
* Knowledge of critical water parameters for various industrial sectors
* Techno-commercial evaluation and costing skills
* Negotiation skills
* Strong communication, networking and presentation skills
* Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment
* Organising and planning skills
* Process and result orientation, self-starter attitude, strong analytical skills

Interested candidates can share their profile to hr19@technomechplacements.com

title: Cyber - Data Protection/CASB - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Consultant in Deloitte’s Cyber practice, you will help clients strengthen data protection capabilities across strategy, design, and implementation efforts. You will support the delivery of data protection solutions that address security, privacy, and regulatory requirements while helping organizations operate with greater confidence in a changing risk landscape. This role offers the opportunity to work across assessments, solution design, deployment, integration, and client enablement in complex enterprise environments.

As a Consultant - Data Protection on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Assess client data protection environments, perform gap analyses, and support the development of remediation recommendations aligned to business and security requirements.
* Contribute to the design of data protection solutions, including technical requirements, high-level design, low-level design, and evaluation of technologies through proof-of-concept activities.
* Deploy, configure, and support data protection technologies across enterprise environments, including migrations, upgrades, high-availability configurations, and platform integrations.
* Develop detection use cases, workflows, and supporting documentation to help clients operationalize and sustain data protection capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, client stakeholders, and third-party vendors to deliver implementation activities, knowledge transfer, and project documentation.

Data and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to do effective utilization of data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global, pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas:
  
  

* Privacy Governance & Compliance
* Data Protection & Compliance
* Digital Trust & Online Protection
* Risk & Controls Enablement
* Technology & Implementation

Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: IST 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience assessing, designing, and implementing data protection strategies and solutions
* Experience performing current-state assessments, gap analyses, and solution architecture for data protection programs
* Experience developing technical requirements, high-level designs, and low-level designs for enterprise data protection implementations
* Experience deploying, configuring, or migrating security or data protection solutions in enterprise environments
* Experience integrating data protection technologies with other security platforms and enterprise systems
* Experience creating architectural, technical, or operational documentation and supporting client knowledge transfer
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience developing detection techniques and customizing workflows within data protection solutions
* Experience working with cloud or hybrid security architectures
* One or more certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor, Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Information Security Manager, cloud security certifications, or vendor certifications in platforms such as Varonis, Netskope, BigID, Imperva, Securiti.ai , Zscaler, Symantec, or Forcepoint

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Ayurcin Biogenics Pvt Ltd is an innovative healthcare company specializing in patented herbal milk products, herbal Nutri-bars, and exporting medicines through contract manufacturing. Its flagship products include Ayur-Enzo Milk, formulated with herbs such as shatavari, ashwagandha, brahmi, shilajit, arjun, and tulsi to help address malnutrition in society. The company also offers Ayubar, an herbal Nutri-bar made from natural herbs, and Ayurbeat, a fully ayurvedic anti-diabetic liquid exported to Mauritius and sold across India, with sales exceeding 70,000 bottles. Ayurcin is incubated at multiple agri and innovation centers including ISB Agri Impact, RKVY Raftaar MANAGE CIA, AIC ADT Baramati Agricultural College, NAFARI, and is a member of ASSOCHAM, reflecting strong industry connections and growth potential for team members.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Pune City. The Salesperson will be responsible for identifying and engaging potential distributors and retailers, presenting product benefits, and demonstrating how Ayurcin’s herbal products can address customer needs. Daily activities include visiting prospects and existing clients, conducting product pitches, following up on leads, closing sales, and meeting assigned sales targets. The role involves coordinating with internal teams on pricing, supply, and delivery, maintaining accurate sales records, and providing feedback from the market to support product and strategy improvements. The Salesperson will also participate in local promotional activities, build long-term relationships with partners, and represent the brand professionally in the field.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to convert leads into long-term business relationships.
* Experience in field sales, FMCG, pharmaceutical, or nutraceutical products, preferably within the Pune region or surrounding markets.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain product features and health benefits in a clear, confident manner.
* Basic understanding of herbal, ayurvedic, or nutritional products and willingness to learn product details in depth.
* Ability to work independently in the field, manage time effectively, and consistently achieve or exceed sales targets.
* Comfort with maintaining records, using mobile or computer-based tools for reporting, and sharing regular updates with the sales team.
* Minimum educational background of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, life sciences, or related fields is an advantage.
* Prior experience in distribution network development or channel sales is highly beneficial.

title: Quantum Treasury Implementation - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
You’ll implement FIS Quantum modules—including Cash Management, Investments, Intercompany, Debt, and FX—for large multinational firms, configuring each to address complex structures. You’ll establish secure banking connectivity via SWIFT and Host-to-Host, and rigorously test integrations. Responsibilities include preparing business requirements documents, blueprints, status reports, and updates, as well as providing go-live support and resolving post-implementation client queries to ensure smooth operations and high client satisfaction.
  
  
**The team:**
Controllership & Treasury Transformation (C&TT) is one of the offerings within the Finance Transformation portfolio of Deloitte US India Consulting. This Offering advises, implements, and delivers solution as-a-service relating to digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, enterprise performance strategies and technologies solutions. By taking a holistic view of these key business areas from strategy development through process design and technology enablement, we help our clients navigate their challenges while continuing to succeed in their business.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Possess 5–8 years of hands-on experience in the Corporate Treasury domain, supporting global organizations with treasury operations and solutions
* Expertise in FIS Quantum Treasury Management System (TMS), having completed 1–2 end-to-end implementation and rollout projects, which involved requirements gathering, module configuration, testing, data migration, and go-live support
* Deep, working knowledge of bank payment systems, including transaction processing, SWIFT and Host-to-Host integrations, and cash accounting processes, ensuring seamless banking connectivity and accurate financial reporting
* Proven ability to handle project-related communications—consistently engaging with stakeholders, collaborating with peers, managing client and team expectations, and effectively presenting value-driven recommendations to optimize treasury processes
* Excellent communication skills are mandatory, additional language skills desirable

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Adaptable and proactive approach to managing multiple workstreams and priorities in dynamic, fast-paced environments, demonstrating strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills to deliver quality outcomes under tight deadlines
* Recognized for building positive working relationships and becoming a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle, contributing to project success and client satisfaction
* Quantum Certification is preferable

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai /Kolkata

**Shift Timings:**

* 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-FT-BF-Hyperion P&E-Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will lead the design, build, and delivery of Oracle Cloud FP&A implementations, working with global teams to turn requirements into deliverables. You will guide junior team members and manage project phases to help deliver timely, high-quality solutions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Business Finance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading the design, development, and deployment of Hyperion Planning, Essbase, Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (PBCS), Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (EPBCS), and Profitability and Cost Management Cloud Service (PCMCS) applications
* Gathering requirements and supporting delivery activities across Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) engagements
* Developing integrations, calculation scripts, business rules, dashboards, forms, and reports to support planning and performance management processes
* Managing testing, user acceptance testing, hypercare, issue resolution, and application performance improvement activities
* Collaborating with business stakeholders, technical teams, and junior practitioners to support solution delivery and team capability development

**The team**
Business Finance, part of our Finance Transformation portfolio, delivers solution-as-a-service offerings focused on digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, and enterprise performance technologies. We take a holistic approach, integrating strategy development, process design, and technology enablement to help clients overcome challenges and achieve sustained business success. Our team partners with organizations to drive profitable growth, manage costs strategically, and navigate financial risks. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong analytical skills and business acumen to join us in delivering innovative solutions and supporting clients in their transformation journey.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* CA, BE, or B.Tech degree
* 6+ years of experience with Oracle Planning
* Experience with Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (EPBCS) or Profitability and Cost Management Cloud Service (PCMCS), including out-of-the-box modules, custom cubes, or reporting cubes
* Experience leading delivery across Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Suite projects
* Experience with business rules, forms, dashboards, data integration, metadata management, and MDX calculations

**Key Responsibilities**

**Qualifications**

We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.

* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.

title: Technology Consulting Manager - AI Engineering
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
The Scaled AI practice at ZS operates at the dynamic intersection of artificial intelligence and cutting-edge technology, dedicated to assisting global clients in developing, operationalizing, and scaling both Classical and Generative AI capabilities. Our team partners with leading organizations across diverse sectors—including pharma (commercial, R&D, and supply chain), travel, retail, and more—to build robust AI applications and platforms that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
As an important growth engine for ZS, Scaled AI has seen rapid expansion, marked by significant increases in both revenue and team size in recent years. This growth reflects the rising demand for enterprise-grade AI solutions and highlights our commitment to driving innovation at scale.
  
  
**Why Join the Scaled AI Team at ZS?**

* Cutting-Edge Work: Contribute to building and scaling advanced Agentic AI systems using the latest frameworks and technologies. Collaborate with AI and technology innovation labs to translate groundbreaking research into practical solutions for clients.
* Enterprise Impact: Deliver AI-driven transformation at scale for some of the world’s most prominent companies, shaping the future of industries with your expertise.
* Empowered to Innovate: Experience the autonomy to explore new ideas, drive innovation, and influence the direction of AI-enabled business transformation.
* Grow with Exceptional Talent: Work alongside outstanding engineers, data scientists, and AI leaders in a supportive, high-performance culture that values collaboration, learning, and excellence.

**Our Culture and Partnership Model**
At ZS, we foster a culture that emphasizes growth, collaboration, and the recognition of talent. Our partnership model is designed to reward exceptional contributions, ensuring that great talent is empowered and celebrated. We believe in nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment where every team member has the opportunity to learn, lead, and make a tangible impact—both within our organization and for our clients worldwide. If you are passionate about AI and ready to lead technical teams in delivering transformative AI solutions, consider joining the Scaled AI team at ZS!
  
  
**What You’ll Do :**

* Lead multiple AI and digital transformation engagements, driving successful delivery from strategy through implementation and scaled adoption.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology stakeholders, provide thought leadership in Scaling and operationalizing AI
* Build and manage client relationships across accounts while identifying opportunities to expand ZS's AI capabilities within existing and new engagements.
* Lead cross-functional teams in designing, building, and scaling enterprise AI applications powered by Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics
* Contribute to Thought leadership by creating POV on industry trends in AI and technology
* Lead hiring initiatives in growing Scaled AI team and mentor technical talent within the team
* Ensure high-quality solution delivery through strong engineering, architecture, and SDLC practices.
* Drive ZS Scaling AI initiatives in tandem with global partners
* Manage budgets, resources, and vendor relationships related to AI tools and platforms
* Stay at the forefront of emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends.
* Work with ZS technology teams to take cutting edge technology implementations and ideas and bring it to the market through focused go-to-market activities

**What You’ll Bring :**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 10-12+ years of experience leading technology, AI, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives within consulting, technology services, or industry environments.
* Proven experience leading client-facing engagements and managing senior stakeholder relationships.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, NLP, Knowledge Retrieval, and modern AI architecture patterns.
* Experience building, deploying, and scaling enterprise AI applications from concept through production.
* Strong knowledge of AI application development, software engineering, cloud architecture, and platform engineering practices.
* Hands-on experience with modern AI and data platforms, including Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks, Dataiku, Snowflake, Vertex AI, or similar ecosystems.
* Experience operationalizing AI through MLOps, LLMOps, model governance, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and data engineering.
* Experience delivering solutions on public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Agile project planning and project management experience
* Team management and skill development experience
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Highly motivated, good work ethic and enterprise maturity
* Life science domain knowledge is a plus

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
description:
**Description**
At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Solution Engineer – Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems**
, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on
**Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**
.
  
  
LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions.
* Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities.
* Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues.
* Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally.

**Partner with the Business**

* Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes.
* Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change.

**Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation**

* Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance.
* Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes.
* Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization.

**Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations**

* Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management.
* Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms.
* Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain.
* Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities.

**Lead Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes.
* Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions.
* Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles.
* Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Technical Expertise -**
**Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* ZhuoMES
* GUSLAB / LABSQ
* Unilab
* Thermo Fisher SampleManager LIMS
* WinLIMS

**OT & Manufacturing Solutions**

* Eschbach Shiftconnector
* AssetWise

**Sustainability & Quality Platforms**

* Credit360
* Other Quality, OT, and R&T SaaS applications

**Additional Capabilities**

* Information architecture (data, process, and application landscape)
* Application lifecycle management
* Systems integration and interfacing
* Change management
* Technical project delivery
* Analytical problem solving
* Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

**What Success Looks Like**
In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working.
  
  
**You Will Be Successful If You Can**

* Balance technology expertise with business understanding.
* Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility.
* Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions.
* Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation.
* Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations.

**Benefits**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com
  
  
*Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.
  
  
**OUR HERITAGE**
With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.
  
  
We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: Sr Strategic Sourcing Spec
description:
**Job Description**
As a Sr Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) in India and EMEA or Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) categories supporting Honeywell manufacturing operations in India and partially APAC.
  
  
You will partner with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Integrated Supply Chain, Finance, and Project Management teams to deliver productivity, improve supplier performance, mitigate commercial and supply risks, and support the successful execution of capital investment and operational reliability initiatives.
  
  
You will apply your manufacturing and strategic sourcing experience to manage complex supplier engagements, lead competitive sourcing events, negotiate commercial agreements, and implement category strategies that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for CAPEX / MRO categories supporting manufacturing operations
* Support the execution of capital investment projects in India and EMEA region, including manufacturing expansion, capacity growth, automation, modernization, and equipment replacement initiatives
* Lead sourcing activities related to manufacturing expansion projects in Pune and Hyderabad
* Manage end-to-end sourcing activities, including requirements review, market analysis, supplier identification, RFx execution, bid evaluation, negotiation, supplier recommendation, contracting, and implementation
* Lead sourcing activities for capital equipment, production machinery, automation systems, manufacturing technologies, installation services, commissioning support, and related technical services
* Develop and implement sourcing strategies for MRO categories, including industrial spare parts, repair and maintenance services, OEM components, industrial consumables, technical services, tools, and reliability-related requirements
* Partner with Engineering and Project Management teams to align sourcing plans with technical specifications, project schedules, budgets, and implementation requirements
* Collaborate with Operations and Maintenance teams to support equipment availability, operational continuity, and manufacturing reliability
* Drive productivity through competitive bidding, supplier negotiations, demand management, value engineering, specification optimization, supplier consolidation, and total cost of ownership analysis
* Conduct supply market analysis and supplier benchmarking to support sourcing decisions
* Monitor supplier performance across quality, delivery, cost, service, responsiveness, and compliance
* Lead supplier performance reviews and establish corrective action and continuous improvement plans as needed
* Evaluate supplier capabilities, capacity, financial health, commercial position, and supply continuity risks
* Develop and execute mitigation plans for supplier, contractual, commercial, and project-execution risks
* Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, payment terms, productivity commitments, warranties, service levels, liability, and other contractual requirements
* Ensure compliance with Honeywell sourcing policies, ethical requirements, approval processes, and contract governance standards
* Support contract development, execution, administration, supplier compliance, and resolution of commercial issues
* Maintain and support accurate sourcing plans, project updates, savings forecasts, supplier information, risk documentation, supporting records, annual productivity, working capital, cost optimization, and supply continuity objectives
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders and gain alignment on sourcing recommendations, supplier selection, and commercial decisions
* Promote standard sourcing processes, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement across the India CAPEX and MRO portfolio

CAPEX strategy includes categories such as processing machinery, test & analytical, automation and process controls, HVAC (Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning), material handling, packaging and other industrial equipment, supplies & services Meanwhile, MRO strategy includes categories such as OEM spare parts, pumps, pipes, valves and fittings, motors, bearings, power transmission, pneumatics, hydraulics, hardware, fasteners, industrial gases, chemicals, lubricants, cutting tools, hand and power tools, electrical supplies, and other industrial materials.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline
* 7 to 10 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Category Management, or a related field
* Demonstrated experience working in or directly supporting a manufacturing environment
* Experience developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for CAPEX and/or MRO categories
* Experience sourcing capital equipment, production machinery, industrial equipment, maintenance services, spare parts, technical services, and/or industrial consumables
* Experience leading competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations
* Experience negotiating supplier contracts, commercial terms, payment terms, warranties, and service-level requirements
* Experience managing supplier relationships and driving supplier performance improvements
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable cost reduction, productivity, working capital, or total cost improvements
* Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, and commercial decision-making skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Finance, Integrated Supply Chain, and Project Management stakeholders
* Ability to communicate effectively in English within a global business environment

**WE VALUE**

* Engineering background combined with strategic sourcing or procurement experience
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and industrial supply markets and possessing strong project management and organizational skills
* Strong knowledge of MRO sourcing, industrial spare parts, maintenance services, OEM requirements, industrial supplies, and reliability-related procurement
* Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, manufacturing expansion, automation, modernization, capacity growth, or equipment replacement projects
* Experience managing sourcing activities from specification development through supplier selection, contracting, delivery, installation, commissioning support, and project closeout
* Experience applying total cost of ownership, should-cost analysis, cost modeling, value engineering, and cost-benefit analysis
* Experience using supplier scorecards, business reviews, corrective actions, and continuous improvement plans
* Knowledge of contract governance, commercial risk management, supplier compliance, and sourcing controls
* Ability to manage multiple sourcing projects and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Strong problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, as well as influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority
* Experience working across global and regional teams in a matrixed organization
* Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence experience mind set
* Knowledge of eSourcing, spend analytics, contract management, and procurement systems.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:

title: Presales Executive
description:
**Job Description- Pre-sales Lead**

**Overview:**
Sellability is on an aggressive, market-redefining growth trajectory, with development mandates spanning residential, commercial and mixed-use projects. We're a merit-driven, entrepreneurial team — the kind of place where ambitious, hard-working people get real ownership early, not after they've proven themselves for years.

At Sellability, you don't just build a job, you build a legacy: fast-tracked career growth, structured mentorship, exposure to marquee developers, and a direct hand in redefining how real estate is sold and marketed in India. Our projects demand year-round market activation and sustained brand salience. As we serve an AOP of INR 5000 Cr+ and growing, Marketing carries a real mandate: project branding, launch and sustenance support, and constant innovation.

**About the role:**

Every sale starts in pre-sales. As Team Lead, you'll run the team that turns enquiries into site visits. That means making sure every lead is called quickly, qualified properly and handed to the closing team ready to convert. You set the pace, coach the callers and own the numbers at the top of the funnel.

**What you will own:**

* **Team performance:**
  Lead and coach a team of pre-sales executives against daily and weekly targets for calls, connects, qualified leads and site visits.
* **Lead management:**
  Make sure every lead, whether from digital, channel partners, events or walk-ins, is contacted within the agreed response time and followed up until it closes out, with the CRM kept accurate.
* **Funnel conversion:**
  Track the funnel from lead to connect, qualified lead, visit scheduled and visit done. Spot where leads drop off and fix it.
* **Quality:**
  Build and refresh pitch scripts and objection handling for each project. Run regular call audits and give feedback.
* **Working with sales:**
  Coordinate with closing managers and site heads on visit scheduling, and feed their visit outcomes back into how the team qualifies leads.
* **Working with marketing:**
  Share lead-quality insights by source and campaign so spend goes where leads actually convert.
* **Reporting:**
  Send daily and weekly reports on team performance and funnel health to the cluster head.
* **Building the team:**
  Hire, onboard and train new pre-sales team members.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 4–6 years in real estate pre-sales or tele-sales, including at least 1–2 years leading a team.
* A strong grip on funnel metrics, and comfort working in a CRM and Excel every day.
* A coach's mindset: you make callers better, not just busier.
* Fluency in English, Hindi and Marathi.
* Knowledge of Pune's residential market is a strong plus.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.

**Location:**
Baner, Pune

**Note:**
Its a 6-day WFO role

**Why Sellability**

* **Growth without limits**
  — Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large-scale launches.
* **Performance with rewards**
  — A merit-driven culture where your strategy, your calls and your outcomes are visible at the top, not buried in a hierarchy.
* **Collaborative culture**
  — Work directly with founder-level leadership, in a transparent, "one team" environment built for people who want to build, not just execute.
* **Purpose & impact**
  — Own the brand for one of the most ambitious portfolios in the market, with the mandate to redefine how real estate is sold and marketed in India.

title: INTEGRATION ARCHITECT L1

͏

viii.    Validate the integration solution/ prototype from technology, cost structure and customer differentiation point of view 
  
ix.    Identify problem areas and perform root cause analysis of integration architectural design and solutions and provide relevant solutions to the problem 
  
x.    Collaborating with sales, program/project, consulting teams to reconcile solutions to architecture

͏

d.    Help in attaining market recognition through analyst rankings, client testimonials and partner credits

g.    Contribute to the integration practice by conducting selection interviews etc.

ii.    Support in hiring adequate and right resources for the team through conducting interviews

**Measure**

The role involves a combination of student counselling, institutional relationship management, outreach, follow-ups and sales, with significant interaction across our partner college network.

* **2–3 years of experience**
  in overseas education, education consulting, student counselling, business development or a related field.

* Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident in speaking with students as well as senior college stakeholders.

title: Proposal Associate
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Our global team continue to our focus on building relationships and delighting our clients (90% of our business is repeat business). In return we have opportunities to work on unique and exciting projects, and a stable platform upon which to develop your career, and a diverse workforce culture where we truly encourage you to bring your whole self to every aspect of your work.
  
  
By working together in international teams and with different perspectives, we gain the experience that is our collective strength. In Jacobs, every day is a chance to make the world a better place - let's design your career with us!
  
  

* As Proposal Associate you will provide ownership of the end-to-end opportunity, working with Subject Matter Experts to develop value propositions that position to win work.
* You own the quality and presentation of our submissions and work with the teams to determine the best approach and style of response.
* The working environment is fast paced, and it is essential to have the ability to balance technical and commercial differentiation to support the Sales Lead in presenting the perfect balance that wins projects which fit our vision.
* You are to be effective at bringing the ideas of others to market; have good judgment about which ideas and suggestions could work; and be able to coordinate the work winning and creative process of others as part of an opportunity team either in a lead or coordinator capacity.
* Working with a high degree of autonomy, you have excellent communication skills and are comfortable with managing priorities and deadlines.
* Highly developed soft skills relating to facilitation, conflict resolution, time management, and instilling an inclusive culture within the opportunity team are all of value.
* Assertiveness and influencing skills ensure your success working with stakeholders in this high-pressured environment. In addition, an ability to work and train team members to use Microsoft, CRM Salesforce, SharePoint, and InDesign are all considered advantageous.
* This is the perfect role for someone who enjoys leading proposal sessions and developing outstanding content.
* Jacobs’ Relationship-Based Sales methodology -
* Champion and lead the implementation of our Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) methodology - especially in Middle Game and End Game for Tier 1 & 2 pursuits. - Apply best practice RBS process to pursuits.
* Work with Sales Leads and Capture Managers/ Operations to develop B&P estimate, gain approval, regularly monitor B&P spending, and report any significant variances of the specific opportunities.
* SOX and ISO certification compliance for the entire proposal is adhered too as it related to the RBS/sales process as part of the opportunity close-out.
* Particularly in relation to governance and recording of Bid/No Bid decisions, Green Reviews, and Sales to Operations handover.
* Develop understanding in review of client terms & conditions, pricing strategies and Jacobs’ financial metrics.
* Work within core Sales Systems and Tools (e.g. CSP, SharePoint and Knowledge Centre). Sales and Marketing Materials & Knowledge
* Develop and maintain qualification materials including project descriptions, experience matrices/overviews, safety and quality statistics, capability statements. Work with Operations to capture and develop performance proofs and client testimonials relevant to the opportunity/proposals.
* Collaborate with Sales Lead and Capture Manager/ Operations in developing distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position relating to Opening Game.
* Share sales materials, information, knowledge, and best practices with other Sales Operations team members company wide.
* Jacobs’ Brand Representative
* Lead by example, be proactive in ensuring health and safety of opportunity team throughout.
* Be an advocate of our BeyondZero culture and company values.
* Lead compliance with our Corporate Identity Program and client confidentiality requirements for all sales documents relating to the opportunity/proposals.
* Provide support to Global Sales e.g., timely preparation of press releases, providing input to our Annual Report, and support of Global Sales initiatives as appropriate.
* Champion Jacobs brand, including working within Brand Guidelines for visual identity and brand voice.
* Opening Game/ Market & Account Strategy - Partner with Market Sales Director, Head of Sector and S&T in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor & market research, development of Market Roadmaps.
* Support Sales Leads and Client Account Managers (CAMs) in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor and market research, development of documented Core Client Strategies, participation in 101s, development of Executive Summaries and White Papers.
* For the industry sectors pursued by your team, develop an understanding of our corporate, regional, and office qualifications including technical, managerial, commercial and competitive strengths that differentiate Jacobs in the marketplace.
* Leverage global network to identify & convey Jacobs’ unique capabilities & resources. Collaborate with S&T and Outside Sales to develop Capability Statements and White Papers. -
* Client Go / No Go and Account Reviews and Focus Windows as required.
* Conduct/ facilitate 101 meetings for key accounts, in partnership with outside Sales. Middle Game (Opportunities)
* Organise, direct, and motivate a multidiscipline opportunity team to develop Middle Game win plans and strategic sales actions and deliverables, or stimulate the assignment of teams for assigned opportunities.
* Actively initiate and partner with sales leads, CAMs and Capture Managers to develop and implement Middle Game action plan, e.g. document due diligence in project brief, develop Win Plan (G to VP), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary, conduct initiate Go/No Go and strategy review, and identify delivery team.
* Actively work with Sales and Operations to develop, implement and monitor Middle Game actions, using Client Success Platform (CSP) [Salesforce] & SharePoint. - Conduct Opportunity Go/No Go and strategy reviews in CSP. - Develop Win Plan (Gaps to Value Proposition), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary.
* Identify execution/delivery teams, coach and support them in the win strategy.
* Challenge concepts, solutions and assumptions in constructive ways to truly differentiate and develop unique value propositions. End Game (Bids & Proposals)
* Arrange or lead the planning and of all elements of End Game, e.g. analyse client request, develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance check-list, response outline, schedule), initiate Go/No Go, conduct Pink Team, conduct kick-off meeting, manage and work with team to develop response sections, refine Executive Summary, conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, schedule Pricing Reviews, ensure on-time delivery of response
* Champion use of Client Success Platform (CSP) for approvals & linked SharePoint for End Game document collaboration.
* Analyse client requests & develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance checklist, writing plan, response outline, schedule).
* When leading an opportunity; initiate Opportunity Bid/No-Bid meetings, conduct Pink Teams, conduct kick-off meetings and record all approvals in CSP, or else check compliance of opportunities assigned to you.
* When leading an opportunity, manage and work with team to develop response sections, especially value propositions and Executive Summaries or else check compliance of opportunities.
* When leading an opportunity conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, Schedule Pricing Reviews. Conduct and record approvals in CSP or else check compliance of opportunities /proposals.
* Ensure on-time delivery of any response within the assigned opportunity. - Support or check if the opportunity close out processes after submission including collaboration with knowledge management is completed.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any relevant Degree with around 9+ years of experience. \* Solution-selling strategy development
* Writing skills
* Marketing/sales coordination
* Facilitation, influencing and group process
* Opportunity/ bid / proposal management
* Business acumen
* Time management and task coordination
* Influencing stakeholders

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Account Management Specialist - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
Responsible for managing customer relationships and account strategies for less complex accounts, including regional, single-business-unit, or internal accounts. The role may also support larger and more complex accounts in partnership with senior account management leaders.
  
  
The position is responsible for driving sales of Cummins products and services to assigned business customers, expanding existing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and executing account plans aligned with business strategy and revenue objectives. The role acts as a key customer interface and advocate for the voice of the customer within Cummins.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, manage, and maintain strong business relationships with assigned accounts in alignment with the organization's sales strategy.
* Develop and execute account strategies and sales plans to achieve revenue, growth, customer satisfaction, and business objectives.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities and support initiatives that contribute to revenue growth and cost reduction.
* Expand sales of Cummins products and services within existing customer accounts by understanding customer requirements and identifying opportunities for growth.
* Lead and coordinate customer communication and interfaces at appropriate stakeholder levels.
* Negotiate and implement customer contracts within established authorization and business guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address production, distribution, service, inventory, and delivery requirements associated with assigned accounts.
* Act as a champion for the voice of the customer and ensure customer needs and feedback are effectively represented within the business.
* Measure customer satisfaction, identify improvement areas, and develop action plans to strengthen the customer experience.
* Support and drive account strategy execution by collaborating with key stakeholders across functions and business units.
* Drive cross-business-unit account development initiatives in support of broader account strategies.
* Lead Customer Focus Six Sigma initiatives and other improvement activities aimed at strengthening customer relationships and business performance.
* Manage accounts receivable deliverables, including discussions and negotiations related to payment terms, as applicable.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and track performance, progress, and forecast accuracy against business targets.
* Monitor account performance, relationship strength, product competitiveness, quality, service, and other key factors to identify risks and opportunities.
* Balance customer requirements with business capabilities related to inventory, service, and delivery, in collaboration with internal stakeholders and customers.
* Use customer and market insights to support account planning, pipeline development, and long-term business growth.

**Key Competencies**
**Customer & Relationship Management**

* Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions.
* Communicates Effectively: Tailors communication across different audiences and stakeholder levels to convey complex information clearly.
* Integrates Customer Perspective: Uses customer insights to improve sales effectiveness, customer experience, and revenue growth.
* Instills Trust: Builds credibility through honesty, integrity, transparency, and authentic interactions.

* Pricing Strategy: Develops and supports pricing approaches by building alignment with relevant stakeholders to achieve business objectives.
* Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, and routes to market to support business growth.

**Sales & Business Development**

* Sales Forecasting: Analyzes internal and external customer data and historical trends to support accurate sales forecasts and future consumption planning.
* Sales Pipeline Management: Monitors pipeline health, prioritizes opportunities, identifies gaps, and supports actions required to achieve sales objectives.
* Sense Making: Uses research, probing, and analysis to understand customer needs, buying behavior, and business drivers and translates insights into relevant solutions and actions.
* Adapts to Target Audience: Communicates technical, commercial, and business information appropriately for different audiences.

**Leadership & Execution**

* Ensures Accountability: Takes ownership of commitments and follows through on deliverables and agreed actions.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic customer-facing environment.
* Strong commercial judgment and problem-solving capability.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, Engineering, a technical discipline, or a related field .

title: Coupa – Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Coupa – Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation**
Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Senior Consultant, Coupa, where you will support digital procurement transformation initiatives across source-to-pay environments. In this role, you will contribute to discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and support activities for Coupa solutions across procurement, sourcing, contracts, supplier management, invoicing, and related modules. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation and post-go-live activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant, Coupa on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting source-to-pay transformation initiatives across client environments.
  
  

* Lead discovery workshops, document business requirements, map current-state processes, identify process gaps, and design future-state workflows aligned to Coupa capabilities.
* Configure and support Coupa modules based on project scope, including Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, and Spend Analytics.
* Support integration design and execution between Coupa and enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, and Workday Financials, including connectors, flat-file integrations, and related data flows.
* Set up master data, catalogs, approval workflows, buying channels, coding rules, supplier onboarding forms, and other components required for end-to-end source-to-pay operations.
* Support testing, defect triage, deployment, user training, hypercare, release updates, post-go-live optimization, and coordination with onsite and offshore teams across the implementation lifecycle.

**The team**
Enterprise Performance
  
  
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
  
  
The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience implementing or supporting Coupa across source-to-pay process areas, including requisitioning, sourcing, contracts, invoicing, supplier management, expenses, or payments
* Experience leading discovery workshops and documenting business requirements, process flows, and functional designs
* Experience configuring Coupa modules such as Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, or Spend Analytics
* Experience supporting integrations between Coupa and enterprise resource planning platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Workday Financials
* Experience setting up master data, catalogs, approval workflows, buying channels, and related configuration components within Coupa
* Experience supporting system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, deployment, or hypercare activities
* Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Bachelor of Technology (BTech), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), Master of Technology (MTech), or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience supporting procurement transformation, roadmap assessments, process re-engineering, or tool selection activities
* Experience with software-as-a-service procurement platforms such as Ivalua, SAP Ariba, or SAP Concur
* Experience supporting service-level agreement-based application support, ticket management, or root cause analysis
* Experience delivering training, user enablement materials, or software demonstrations for procurement platforms
* Experience supporting quarterly release management, upgrade planning, or post-go-live optimization
* Coupa or procurement platform certifications

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**

Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Consultant, Coupa, where you will support digital procurement transformation initiatives across source-to-pay environments. In this role, you will contribute to discovery, design, configuration, integration, testing, and deployment activities for Coupa solutions across procurement, sourcing, contracts, supplier management, invoicing, and related modules. title: Default Job Template
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer II is a senior technical person who partners with government
  
  
customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product
  
  
configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database
  
  
expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the

most complex government implementations across the United States
  
  

* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data,

resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
  
  

* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and

migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder

like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the
  
  
deployment and integration process
  
  

* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to

simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
  
  

* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their

configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
  
  

* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable

tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
  
  

* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and

channel field feedback into the product roadmap
  
  
**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical

consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
  
  

* 3+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data

transformation, and reconciliation
  
  

* 2+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts

and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
  
  

* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or

provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
  
  

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on

data and configuration for accuracy
  
  

* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving

customer needs
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.
