title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Who we are?**
Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since.
  
  
Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. Sustainability is a top priority for our company.
  
  
We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R&D in climate-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Johnson Controls Digital Solutions is looking for an experienced engineer with a deep knowledge on building technologies including BMS, VMS, and Access Control etc.
  
  
As a member of the Global Center of excellence the Presales technical lead will help customers to make technology decisions, implement best practices for asset management and overall facilitate transforming buildings into smart connected entities.
  
  
This role requires a blend of technical expertise, customer service, and sales skills to effectively support potential clients and the sales team in understanding, evaluating, and adopting the company's digital products and solutions. You are obsessed with driving continuous process improvements to optimize solution and deliverables in presales process.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Develop and implement pre-sales strategies that align with the organization’s business goals & targets.
* Review opportunity inputs, requirements and specifications; should be able to capture the Digital Solution scope and understand the complete requirements of the customer.
* Drive RFP/RFI responses, preparing technical solution writeups, compliance matrices, BoQs, Hardware sizing calculations, and architecture diagrams tailored to customer use cases across global markets.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product management, and engineering, to ensure alignment and effective Solution development.
* Translate customer pain points and site realities into solution architectures, integrating PLC/SCADA systems and BMS Platforms (Metasys, Niagara, DDC, JACE or similar) with analytics platform, digital twins, and enterprise FM platforms to demonstrate clear business outcomes.
* Design and present tailored solutions that demonstrate the value and benefits of the digital products and services.
* Conduct requirement workshops, technical discovery sessions, and PoCs, ensuring alignment of customer expectations with solution capabilities, integration pathways, data models, KPIs, and future‑state architecture.
* Lead and mentor design teams during solution shaping; guiding them on OT and IOT protocols, data ingestion, middleware integration, and standard deployment patterns used during customer demo and Proof of Concepts.
* Preparation and participation for Gate 0 calls / review meetings with JC Branch sales team for technical queries, scope clarifications, compliance and record minutes of meeting.
* Understand inter-dependence and lead cross-functional teams towards technical solutions for multi-tiered systems.
* Clarify, prioritize and drive solution commitments as well as establish and maintain clear chains of accountability.
* Adherence to proposal & estimation process and guideline to select proper Digital Solution Applications/offering to come up with the technical solution.
* Preparing technical proposals, cost estimates ensuring it meet the customer requirement and provide competitive advantage to JCI.
* Develop solutions specific dashboards, reporting frameworks, and data modeling strategies as part of presales demonstrations, highlighting portfolio‑level insights and operational benefits.
* Provide technical leadership to coordinate, prioritize and deliver proposal, commercials in pre-sales process.
* Articulate goals, desired outcomes, risks/issues and mitigation plan clearly in pre-sales process.
* Clearly qualify out of the box solutions and possible customizations needed.
* Provide feedback to product management and development teams regarding customer needs and market demands

**What We Look For**

* 8-10+ years’ experience as Presales engineer and delivering proposals, commercials in overall Bid process.
* Expertise in Solutioning, designing and delivering building technology Solutions e.g. BMS, Security, Fire and Lighting.
* Hands-on experience in SCADA Platforms (WinCC, Iconics, Ignition or similar) and PLC programming is preferred.
* Experience in IoT Gateway configuration and Device Onboarding to cloud is a must have.
* Knowledge of different types of OT/IT network protocols like BACnet, Modbus, OPC, MQTT, SNMP, AMQP and other protocols.
* knowledge of HVAC or Industrial Process Control systems, IT-OT Integrations, API integrations.
* Knowledge of L2 and L3 Networking, Switching, Servers, Virtualization concepts and Clustering.
* knowledge of cloud IoT platforms and services (MS Azure is preferred)
* Familiar with Energy Management, Cloud based Analytics tools, Digital Twin, Digital asset management and BRICK schema concepts.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities in an energizing and fast-paced environment.
* Experience working with industry leaders to understand current technology trends and relevancy.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and new product features.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new products and technologies.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in using Integrated software and digital communication tools.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

description:
Are you commercially minded, analytical, and passionate about enabling business growth? Do you enjoy partnering with Sales and Finance to structure deals that balance

?

If you have strong business acumen, a head for numbers, and the ability to influence stakeholders, this could be an opportunity for you.

**Your Role**

As a Deal Architect, you will serve as a trusted commercial partner to Sales, supporting opportunities across the deal lifecycle through deal structuring, pricing, financial analysis, commercial governance, and execution. You will collaborate cross-functionally to develop profitable solutions, manage risks, ensure financial controls, and help Sales navigate complex deals effectively.

**What You'll Do**

* Act as a trusted commercial advisor to Sales, partnering throughout the deal lifecycle to structure competitive, financially viable, and profitable deals.
* Perform rigorous pricing, cost, margin, profitability, discount, risk, and commercial analysis while ensuring strong financial governance and appropriate controls.
* Proactively manage the deal pipeline, prioritize critical and quarter-closing opportunities, drive timely approvals, and support accurate 30–60-day forecasting.
* Build strong product and commercial expertise to evaluate complex, multi-product and multi-service opportunities and their overall financial impact.
* Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, Contract Management, Product, and other stakeholders to resolve deal complexities and improve speed to market.
* Enable Sales teams through guidance on pricing methodologies, commercial processes, approval requirements, new products, tools, and system enhancements.
* Drive process improvement, standardization, and automation to improve turnaround time, productivity, data quality, controls, and overall deal effectiveness.
* Support continuous transformation to create greater capacity for strategic, complex, and higher-value deal activities.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* **Master's degree**
  , preferably in
  **Finance**

**Experience**

* **4-6 years of relevant experience**
  in areas such as:
* Deal Architecture / Deal Desk
* Commercial Structuring
* Pricing
* Financial Analysis
* Commercial Finance
* Sales Operations
* Revenue or Deal Management

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Strong financial & commercial acumen across pricing, margins, costs, and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound business judgment.
* Effective cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and Contract Management.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to balance business growth with financial controls and commercial discipline.
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple deals and competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, pricing tools, CRM, dashboards, and automation solutions.
* Product and competitive landscape knowledge is an added advantage.
* Strong team collaboration and ability to support new business/product opportunities.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Deal Architect will:

* Enable Sales to move deals forward quickly and effectively while maintaining commercial discipline.
* Provide strong, data-driven recommendations on pricing, profitability, and deal structure.
* Build credibility as a trusted advisor to Sales and Finance stakeholders.
* Proactively identify commercial risks and opportunities.
* Contribute to automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of the deal process.
* Help improve deal turnaround time, pricing consistency, profitability, and overall stakeholder experience.

title: Travel Consultant
description:
About the Role

At
**Waari – Travel Uniquely Different**
, we believe luxury is not just about where you travel, but how you experience the world.

We are looking for a passionate, detail-oriented, and well-travelled
**Luxury Travel Consultant**
who can transform travel aspirations into extraordinary, tailor-made journeys. From handpicked luxury stays and private transfers to immersive cultural encounters and exclusive experiences, you will craft itineraries that reflect each traveller’s unique preferences, personality, and definition of luxury.

As the primary point of contact throughout the travel journey, you will combine destination expertise, creative itinerary design, and exceptional client service to deliver seamless, memorable experiences for discerning travellers.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Crafting Bespoke Luxury Experiences**

* Design highly personalised domestic and international itineraries tailored to clients’ interests, travel styles, budgets, and expectations.
* Curate premium and luxury experiences, including boutique and luxury hotels, private guided tours, exclusive excursions, fine dining, and unique local encounters.
* Develop in-depth knowledge of luxury destinations, emerging travel trends, exceptional properties, and offbeat experiences across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa, and beyond.
* Manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, luxury accommodation, private transfers, rail journeys, curated activities, and destination experiences.

**2. Luxury Sales & Client Relationship Management**

* Engage with discerning clients, understand their travel aspirations, and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through consultative selling.
* Recommend and upsell relevant premium services, room categories, exclusive experiences, private guides, and other value-added offerings.
* Build long-term relationships by understanding individual client preferences and delivering consistently personalised service.
* Drive repeat business, referrals, and revenue growth within the luxury FIT segment.

**3. Seamless Travel Operations**

* Ensure accuracy in bookings, travel documentation, confirmations, vouchers, visa information, and pre-departure communication.
* Coordinate effectively with international DMCs, hotels, airlines, and ground-handling partners to deliver seamless travel experiences.
* Provide timely on-tour assistance and resolve unexpected changes or travel disruptions with professionalism and composure.
* Maintain detailed client records, itinerary documentation, and sales pipelines using travel CRM systems.

**4. Destination Expertise & Continuous Learning**

* Stay updated on luxury travel trends, emerging destinations, premium hospitality offerings, and experiential travel.
* Build strong supplier relationships to access quality services, competitive commercial terms, and distinctive experiences.
* Continuously enhance destination knowledge to create itineraries that go beyond the conventional and deliver genuine value.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in tailor-made travel, luxury FIT, premium holiday planning, or customised international travel.
* Strong knowledge of international destinations, flight connectivity, seasonality, accommodation options, and ground logistics.
* A genuine appreciation for luxury hospitality, experiential travel, and personalised service.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to create compelling, well-presented itineraries.
* Strong sales, negotiation, client relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in travel CRM systems and itinerary planning tools.
* Exceptional attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple itineraries simultaneously.
* A customer-first mindset and the ability to remain calm and resourceful when plans change.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

Someone who understands that luxury is personal. You enjoy discovering extraordinary places, have an eye for detail, think creatively, and take pride in making complex travel arrangements feel effortless. You are equally comfortable building client relationships, designing imaginative itineraries, and ensuring every detail is executed flawlessly.

Why Join Waari?

Be part of a growing travel company with a 22-year legacy, a customer-first philosophy, and an ambition to redefine personalised travel. At Waari, you will have the opportunity to create meaningful journeys, work with distinctive global experiences, and help shape the future of bespoke luxury travel.

**If you believe exceptional journeys begin with exceptional people, we would love to hear from you.**

**📩 Apply now or share your profile with us.**

* **Waari – Travel Uniquely Different.**

title: Senior Energy Market Analyst (Support)
description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Role**

Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self-motivated and professional person for the role of
**Senior Energy Market Analyst**
in our Support Division. The company has consistently grown its global client base and the successful candidate will have many opportunities to interface with a diverse mix of clients with the goal of enhancing their software user experience.

**Responsibilities:**
•    Learn our software to an advanced level
  
•    Provide technical support to customers and track support cases from start to finish
  
•    Work with clients to resolve issues related to our SaaS/Cloud offerings and our Desktop version
  
•    Collaborate with Cloud Developers and Engine/GUI Developers to ensure issues are resolved and development requests are properly documented
  
•    Provide onsite and web-based trainings to existing and potential clients
  
•    Maintain and update training materials
  
•    Compose articles and produce videos to educate clients and to market our software.
  
•    Construct tools and examples that clients can utilize to more effectively utilize our software
  
•    Assist in maintaining software user documentation and help platforms
  
•    Maintain a high level of power market knowledge, news, trends and developments
  
•    Communicate market trends and customer requirements with the development team as needed
  
•    Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients
  
•    Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences
  
•    Travel to client sites as required

**Qualifications, Skills & Experiences:**
•    Bachelor’s degree: Electrical Engineering, Another Engineering Degree, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Applied Math, Physics, or related field.
  
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques
  
•    Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers
  
•    Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities
  
•    Team player, with the ability to be a self-starter and work independently as needed.

**Education:**
•    4 to 7 years of demonstrated working knowledge of power plant operations, electricity and gas markets.
  
•    Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approaches
  
•    Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings
  
•    Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
  
•    Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL
  
•    Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)
  
•    Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models.
  
•    Degree or certificate specializing in Power Markets.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships**
This role works collaboratively with all Energy Exemplar staff, particularly:

•    Indian Development Centre colleagues
  
•    Senior IDC Management
  
•    Chief Product Officer
  
•    Global Product Delivery Team
  
•    Global Product Development Team
  
•    Global Support Team

**Working Hours**

The support team operates across shifts including:

* 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST
* 7:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST

You will initially commence on the 1pm to 10pm shift pattern. Please note that shift schedules are expected to change from January, and we are looking for candidates who are flexible and open to working across all shift patterns as required.

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

*Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.*

description:

We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.*

**Job Description**

Job Title: Principal Specialist – Offer Support

Employment type: KC Role, Demag Distribution India.

KPI:

1. Punctuality

1. Timely release of offer data.
2. Compliance with agreed offer turnaround time.
3. Timely response to Sales and distributor requirements.

2. Accuracy

1. Accuracy of technical offer data.
2. Compliance with customer requirements/RFE.
3. Accuracy of product selection, sizing and BOM.

3. Performance

1. Effective data maintenance.
2. Development of technically and commercially optimized solutions.
3. Effective support to Sales and distributors.
4. Contribution to continuous improvement initiatives.

4. Sales & Distributor Support

1. Response time, technical support, customer meetings and successful resolution of queries
2. Process improvements, standardization, product training
3. Commercial Optimization & Profitability
4. Improvement in margins
5. Optimized technical solutions, cost-effective component selection

Role and Responsibility:

Customer Requirement & Technical Solution

1. Understand the customer’s requirements, application and ultimate objective.
2. Recommend the most appropriate, feasible, simple and economical solution.
3. Provide alternative solutions wherever required.
4. Ensure the proposed solution complies with applicable technical standards and organizational capabilities.
5. Prepare detailed technical solutions covering the complete scope of supply.
6. Support branches/distributors by providing checklists and identifying the required technical inputs.

Offer Engineering & Commercial Support

1. Prepare and release accurate offer data within the agreed timeline.
2. Provide technical and commercial inputs for supply, transportation and service.
3. Support commercial optimization to improve project profitability and competitiveness.
4. Coordinate with the second-level Offer Support team for non-standard and complex enquiries.
5. Ensure timely submission of offers to the Demag Sales Front Line.
6. Handle spare-parts offering activities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

1. Coordinate with Engineering for high-value and customized solutions.
2. Participate in technical discussions with Sales, Engineering and Manufacturing teams.
3. Accompany Sales/branches during customer interactions whenever technical support is required.

SAP, BOM & Order Support

1. Create and update Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP for non-standard projects.
2. Ensure BOM data is accurate and released within the required timeframe.
3. Review customer POs for technical and commercial requirements.
4. Participate in Project Kick-Off Meetings (KOMs).
5. Support order execution and resolve technical/offer-related issues during project execution.

Process & Continuous Improvement

1. Monitor and ensure adherence to defined SOPs and offering processes.
2. Identify gaps in the offer process and implement improvement actions.
3. Develop improvement plans to increase offer accuracy, efficiency and profitability.
4. Maintain relevant offer data and support data-driven decision making.
5. Contribute to standardization of technical solutions, checklists and offering practices.

Training & Knowledge Development

1. Conduct product and application training for Demag Sales Front-Line teams.
2. Conduct product training for Distributor Front-Line teams.
3. Share technical knowledge, product updates and application learnings with internal stakeholders.
4. Support development of technical documentation, guidelines and training material.

**Qualifications**

Education Required: BE Electrical/ Mechanical

Professional Experience Required (Max – Min.): 7-10 years

Gender: Male /Female

Competencies and Skills Required:

Technical Competencies

The candidate should have:

1. Strong knowledge of EOT and industrial crane applications.
2. Good knowledge of crane standards such as IS 3177, IS 4137, CMAA and FEM.
3. Experience in Hot Metal Handling Crane design/application.
4. Knowledge of mechanical and electrical component selection and sizing.
5. Understanding of crane duty classification and application requirements.
6. Ability to interpret technical specifications, drawings and customer requirements.
7. Knowledge of cranes, their components and application.
8. Understanding of techno-commercial offer preparation.
9. Experience in handling customized and non-standard crane requirements.

Software & Digital Skills

1. SAP – BOM creation/update and related activities.
2. Efecte – service/process-related system activities.
3. MS Excel – data analysis, calculations and data management.
4. MS Office / PowerPoint – technical presentations and documentation.
5. Ability to work with engineering/configuration and digital offering tools.

Behavioral Competencies

1. Customer-oriented approach.
2. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
3. Solution-oriented mindset.
4. Good communication and interpersonal skills.
5. Strong coordination and stakeholder-management capability.
6. Ability to work independently and take ownership.
7. Good team player.
8. Attention to detail and accuracy.
9. Ability to work under time pressure and meet deadlines.
10. Strong presentation and training skills.
11. Commercial awareness and profitability mindset.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

The candidate should have awareness of:

1. ISO 9001 – Quality Management
2. ISO 14001 – Environmental Management
3. ISO 45001 – Occupational Health & Safety
4. Applicable crane safety and technical standards

**Additional Information**

Work Environment (Hybrid): Office Primarily (Pune) and based on need may travel to distributor & customers location.

*With the Demag brand we are one of the world’s leading suppliers of industrial cranes, crane components and comprehensive service. We offer our customers a complete range of cranes, handling equipment and drives for every application – optimized by comprehensive sales and service support. The Demag crane experts always focus on the benefits for our customers – the greatest possible availability, optimum performance and maximum efficiency and reliability.*

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
**About Druva**
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
  
  
Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
  
  
Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Professional Services Consultant has a responsibility to discover, design, consult, and implement Druva solutions for new and existing customers and provide best practices and guide the customer during the entire implementation cycle. In addition, this would also include providing technical consultation on Druva’s Data Security Services and Disaster Recovery Services and conducting Cyber Simulations, Security assessments, assistance with Ransomware Recovery and Disaster Recovery Playbooks and Runbooks, configuration and integration of SIEM/SOAR tools, etc. As a member of the Professional Services team, this role will engage and drive customer success. Candidates for this pivotal position are highly dynamic and seasoned professionals with soft and technical skills.
  
  
As a Professional Services Consultant, you will interact with peers around the globe and be a mentor to your team. The ability to effectively scale your interactions from highly technical I.T. staff to key stakeholders at the Executive level is a must. Flexibility in your current skill set and a demonstrable eagerness to learn new things are key criteria to any candidate for this position.
  
  
You will work in a team of individual contributors who are empowered to make decisions and run their daily business tasks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Discover, Design, Deploy, and Optimize Druva Solutions to meet customer requirements
* Lead end to end product deployments and configurations for all lines of business in Druva related to Enterprise Workloads, End User Protection, SaaS Applications and Ransomware and Disaster Recovery practices
* Conduct Cyber Simulation exercises and Security assessments to test customer’s readiness to handle a cyber attack as well as identify gaps within existing security practices and provide recommendations to mitigate the same
* Conduct Security Penetration testings
* Assist with Incident Response Plans, Recovery Playbooks and Cyber Recovery.
* Assist with SIEM/SOAR integrations and configurations between the Customer and Druva’s environment
* Build Project Plans, and organize and manage all phases of a project to ensure successful implementation. This includes developing technical solutions and managing project plans, project schedules, success criteria, and milestones
* Consult with customers and internal teams on best practices and meet expectations
* Communicate status to key stakeholders on project status to drive the outcome
* Timely responsiveness to customer satisfaction
* Manage customer relationships and perform environmental health assessments of product adoption and data resiliency
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on customer requests and feature/product enhancements

**Desired Skills And Experience**

* 8+ years in technical customer-facing roles with at least 2+ years as a Consultant
* Leading and assisting the team and driving large customer implementation across all customers for Enterprise Workloads, End User protection, SaaS Applications, Ransomware Recovery, Disaster Recovery practices
* Expert level knowledge of Operating Systems including MS Windows, Linux and Mac.
* Experience with IDP, SSO Tools, SCCM/Casper/Jamf/intune Deployment tools, Virtual environments (VMWare, VMC, HyperV, AWS, Azure, Nutanix), Storage Technologies (SAN/NAS)
* Knowledge of Networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Bandwidth Management, Firewalls), Cloud Technologies using AWS/Azure/M365/Google Workspace as well as Security Solutions.
* Fast Learner in a dynamic environment with changing priorities
* Experience in conducting Cyber Simulation Exercises with multiple stakeholders
* Experience in conducting Risk Assessments
* Experience in curating IR playbooks and runbooks
* Experience in handling a cyber recovery process
* Experience with automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python, etc.
* Exposure to API’s
* Results-oriented with the ability to prioritize activities, plan and organize to meet commitments
* Excellent presentation, communication (verbal & written), and relationship-building skills, across all levels of management including negotiations and risk abatement
* Excellent consultative approach to customer engagements
* Working knowledge of SaaS demonstrating deep knowledge of SaaS practices
* Ability to work in a cross-functional team environment and collaborate with key partners to drive customer engagement and experience
* Understanding of automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python, etc would be an added advantage. .

**Requirements**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise server backup technology
* Working Knowledge and practical experience administrating Virtual Infrastructure.
* Backup & Restore of File, NAS, MSSQL,MYSQL, Oracle Servers, SAP HANA, AHV, VMware, EC2, Azure VM, VMC, Nutanix, EP, SFDC, M365, Gsuite etc.
* Working Knowledge of AWS services - mainly EC2, S3, RDS, IAM & VPC.
* Hands on experience with conducting Cyber Simulation exercises to identify security vulnerabilities and provide recommendations to mitigate the gaps
* Working knowledge of SIEM/SOAR tools and industry-wide ransomware recovery practices
* Knowledge of Blue team activities and its related tasks
* Understanding of project management methodologies and processes
* Exposure to Storage protocols SAS, Fibre Channel, SCSI, iSCSI
* Understanding of SaaS applications such as M365, Google Workspace, Salesforce etc.
* Understanding of Network Technologies and protocols – TCP/IP, VLAN, DNS, switches, firewalls, routers
* Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python etc.
* CISM or Security+ certified preferred.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Title and Summary
  
  
Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value.
* Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready.
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize.
* Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not.
* Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation.
* Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus

what requires a platform build.
  
  

* Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes.
* Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients.
* Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built.
* Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage.
* Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning.
* Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon.
* Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker.
* Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped.
* Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself.

Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
**Responsibilities**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Technology Commercial Support - Growth
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology pricing professional to lead the commercial design and pricing of complex, high-value opportunities during the pre-signature phase. This location-agnostic role sits within Technology Commercial Support, Growth, and reports to a Senior Technology Account Manager or market-specific Technology Account Manager.
  
  
You will act as the pricing lead for strategic opportunities, typically valued at €10 million to €30 million in total contract value, or support larger and more complex bids. You will develop value-led, competitive and governable commercial constructs while protecting margin, addressing commercial risk and aligning pricing decisions with market conditions.
  
  
Working across defined strategic accounts, sub-accounts or opportunity portfolios, you will collaborate with Technology Account Managers, pricing teams, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments, Digital & IT leaders and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Pricing and commercial design
  
  

* Shape end-to-end commercial constructs for new technology opportunities, aligning the pricing approach with deal strategy, customer requirements and risk profile
* Define pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* Build, review and approve complex pricing models, including sensitivity, scenario and profitability analysis
* Apply relevant pricing constructs, including time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share models
* Clearly document and govern pricing assumptions, commercial risks, dependencies and guardrails
* Set pricing strategies and commercial constructs within Growth governance, escalating material risks or deviations where required
* Provide commercial analysis, market insight and competitor perspectives to support informed pricing decisions

Bid support and governance
  
  

* Lead pricing activity within bid squads for opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, or provide pricing leadership within larger, multi-tower bids
* Coordinate commercial inputs for requests for information, requests for proposal and customer submissions
* Create detailed pricing models, submission packs, proposal artefacts and governance documentation
* Assure the quality, consistency, accuracy and completeness of all pricing deliverables
* Coordinate with solution, pricing and commercial support teams to meet bid timelines and quality requirements
* Support opportunity and pipeline qualification, together with pricing approval processes, in line with Growth governance
* Maintain disciplined delivery across multiple customers and concurrent opportunities
* Enable an effective transition from Growth to business-as-usual teams by documenting pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails

Stakeholder and customer engagement
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with key VOIS stakeholders, customer service owners and service leads
* Work closely with Senior Technology Account Managers, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments and Digital & IT leaders
* Participate in customer engagement activities and contribute commercial insight to the shaping of deals and solutions
* Communicate pricing strategies, commercial risks and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
* Guide commercial support colleagues working within bid teams

Measures of success
  
  

* Competitiveness of pricing and contribution to successful deal outcomes
* Protection of margin and realisation of value on signed opportunities
* Quality and governance of pricing models, submissions and supporting artefacts
* On-time delivery of pricing inputs for bids and proposals
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and guardrails into business-as-usual execution

**Who You Are**
Essential knowledge and capabilities
  
  

* You have expert capability in pricing, financial modelling and commercial analysis
* You demonstrate commercial acumen and a detailed understanding of deal economics, profitability and risk drivers
* You can design and communicate pricing strategies for complex technology opportunities
* You have advanced Microsoft Excel skills and can develop complex financial models, sensitivity analyses and commercial scenarios
* You apply a high level of attention to detail, structured governance and quality assurance
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally with senior internal and customer stakeholders
* You use relevant market and competitor insight to inform pricing decisions
* You can prioritise effectively and manage concurrent work across multiple customers and opportunities
* You demonstrate Vodafone Spirit behaviours
* You apply independent judgement to create tailored commercial approaches rather than relying solely on standard pricing methods

**Experience**

* You have extensive pricing or commercial support experience in IT services, telecommunications or systems integration
* You will typically bring 15 to 18 years of overall professional experience, including 7 to 10 years in senior pricing, bid or commercial roles
* You have practical knowledge of time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share pricing constructs
* Experience acting as the pricing authority for large, complex, multi-tower deals is preferred
* A postgraduate qualification in Finance, Business, IT or Management is highly desirable

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to shape the pricing and commercial strategy for complex, high-value technology deals
* Exposure to strategic opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, as well as larger multi-tower bids
* Collaboration with senior commercial, financial, technology and customer stakeholders across Vodafone and VOIS
* The opportunity to influence deal competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* A location-agnostic role with exposure to multiple customers and opportunity portfolios
* The ability to contribute to customer engagement, solution shaping and commercial decision-making

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced pricing strategy for complex technology and telecommunications opportunities
* Commercial design across time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share constructs
* Scenario modelling, sensitivity analysis and financial risk assessment
* Pricing governance and the preparation of approval and submission artefacts
* Commercial leadership across multi-disciplinary bid teams
* Customer engagement, senior stakeholder communication and deal-shaping techniques
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails into business-as-usual delivery

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

description:
**Job Description**
The purpose of having a project manager is to coordinate all project activities from initiation to completion, ensuring that objectives are achieved on time, within scope, and budget. They serve as a liaison between stakeholders and team members, facilitating effective communication and managing expectations. Project managers efficiently allocate resources, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. By maintaining documentation and reporting on progress, they provide visibility into the project's status and foster a culture of continuous improvement for future projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Project Planning: Develop a detailed project plan outlining objectives, scope, resources, timeline, and budget.
* Team Leadership: Lead and manage the project team, ensuring effective collaboration and communication among team members.
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, equipment, and materials.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress and addressing concerns.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project success.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure that project deliverables meet predefined quality standards and requirements.
* Monitoring & Reporting: Track project progress through key performance indicators and prepare regular status reports for stakeholders.
* Budget Management: Oversee the project budget, ensuring expenditures stay within limits and financial resources are used appropriately.
* Problem Solving: Address challenges and obstacles that arise during the project lifecycle to keep the project on track.
* Closing the Project: Conduct project closure activities, including final deliverable acceptance, documentation, and team debriefing.

* Leadership: Ability to inspire and motivate team members to achieve project goals.

* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Problem-Solving: Proficiency in analyzing problems, generating solutions, and making decisions quickly.
* Negotiation: Skill in negotiating resources, contracts, and stakeholder needs to achieve project objectives.
* Technical Knowledge: Understanding of the specific industry or technical aspects relevant to the project.
* Budgeting: Ability to create and manage budgets effectively to keep projects on track financially.
* Organizational Skills: Strong organizational abilities to juggle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Adaptability: Capacity to adjust to changing circumstances and respond to unforeseen challenges.

**Key Success Factors (Key Metrics / KPIs / Deliverables)**

* Driving sales for break through Initiatives (BTI), Core Growth Initiatives (CGI)

* Drive regulatory approval and customer AVL

* Willing to travel 5 days in a month to SEA countries
* Improve the project margin 2% to 5% from booking.
* Control the project resources within the budget
* Revenue Recognition as per the project schedule
* Good or Improve customer experience based on customer feedback (survey)

**Qualifications**
**Work Experience Required**

* 8-10 years with at least 4 years in on HON or competitors FI product portfolio
* Proven business experience in multiple vertical markets, including field products industries. Networking within the instrumentation industry- large customers, OEM's, EPC's and Consultants will be a strong advantage.

**Specific Knowledge Required**

title: Business Line Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Business Line Manager

**Reports To:**
Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Pune

**Purpose of the role**

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We're looking for a highly accomplished and Senior Technical Consultant with 5+ years of experience to lead the charge on complex AI agentic deployments. This role demands a seasoned technologist and strategic partner who can not only design and develop bespoke solutions leveraging our Agentforce platform and other cutting-edge technologies but also lead technical engagements and mentor junior peers.
