title: Controls Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Design & Estimation incumbent serves as the primary technical authority for IBMS scope definition, system architecture design, cost estimation, and technical proposal development across mission-critical data centre bids. The role demands deep expertise in Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS), a thorough understanding of BMS/DDC/PLC controller ecosystems, and the ability to translate complex client requirements into compelling, commercially sound technical proposals.
* Working at the intersection of Engineering, Sales, and Solution Architecture, the IBMS System Architecture Expert drives technical credibility during the bid cycle — from RFP/RFQ receipt through final bid submission and post-bid technical clarification.

**B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation & Proposal Development**
**C. Technical Proposals & Bid Documentation**
**D. Client Engagement & Presales Support**
**E. Internal Collaboration & Presales Standards**
3. AUTHORITIES
  
  

* KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
* System Architecture & Scope Definition
* Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems.
* Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture — specifying primary, field-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA).
* Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase.
* Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI).
* Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture.
* Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS-to-DCIM interoperability architecture for high-density and AI data center environments.
* Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design.
* Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements.
* Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations.
* Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit-cost rationale for each IBMS bid.
* Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality.
* Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate.
* Prepare and maintain IBMS-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC).
* Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes — presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads.
* Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters.
* Develop technical write-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators — tailored to client technical and commercial requirements.
* Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016) against the proposed solution.
* Produce scope-of-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project.
* Develop technical clarification logs and pre-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness.
* Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity.
* Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions.
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders.
* Participate in pre-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities.
* Support post-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants.
* Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets.
* Provide technical input to sales team's go/no-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions.
* Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements.
* Conduct lessons-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality.
* Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards.
* Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology.
* Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales.

The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Presales & Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function:
  
  

* Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits.
* Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign-off for standard scope items.
* Recommend go/no-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer.
* Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre-bid meetings, and scope discussions.
* Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation.
* Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer.
* Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds.

4. QUALIFICATIONS
**4.1 Education**

* Dip OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Automation & Control, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure.
* Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre-sales engineering is a positive differentiator.
* Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.

**4.2 Experience**

* 5–7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission-critical data center projects.
* Hands-on experience with BMS controller platforms — DDC/PLC platforms.
* Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC-UA, REST API).
* Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016.
* Exposure to high-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous.

**4.3 Technical Skills Matrix**
**Skill Area**
**Proficiency Required**
**IBMS Subsystems**
Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities.
  
  
**Controller Platforms**
Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems.
  
  
**BOQ & Cost Estimation**
Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort.
  
  
**Network & Integration Architecture**
Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA), switch sizing, and third-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS).
  
  
**Technical Proposal Writing**
Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope-of-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids.
  
  
**Standards & Codes**
Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G-FI-PL-006).
  
  
**Thermal Management**
Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high-density environments.
  
  
**Software Tools**
MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms.
  
  
**SCADA / HMI / DCIM**
Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring.
  
  
**4.4 Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy.
* Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively.
* Self-motivated with a quality-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle.

5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity.
* Familiarity with AI data center workloads — high-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.
* Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture.
* Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages.
* Demonstrated experience with multi-hyperscale or multi-colocation client environments — understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements.
* Familiarity with sustainability-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers.

6. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS
  
  

* Primarily office-based role with occasional site visits required for pre-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events.
* Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure.
* Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi-bid parallel cycles.
* Travel required: approximately 10–25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

title: Relationship Manager - Private Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

As a Relationship Manager in Private Banking Group, you would act as a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers comprising of High Net worth Individuals, Family Offices and Institutions. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs that comprises of various asset classes and investment propositions. The core philosophy to hold is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like investment solutions covering equities, commodities, Mutual Funds, Insurance product amongst others. As a Relationship Manager, the focus is on ensuring the needs of the customers are covered through the customer-360 degree approach without any particular allegiance to product or domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service:**
Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Business Development:**
Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Champion 360-degree banking:**
Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality:**
Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer.

**Customised solutions:**
As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.

**Behold our values:**
Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification:**
MBA/PGDM with 2 years of experience/Graduates with 6 years in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.

**Synergize with Team:**
Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise:**
Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.

**Market Sensing:**
Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**Communication:**
Good oral and written communication skills.

**About the Business group**

ICICI Bank’s Private Banking Group (PBG) offers comprehensive investment solutions and services to high net worth individuals and Family offices across India and international geographies. We emphasize on our high quality investment management services along with leading banking and allied group capabilities.

Fulfilling the investment needs and aspirations of our clients is our constant endeavour. * Develop highly productive customer relationships and become a Trusted Advisor by providing thought leadership to help shape and grow our value to the customer

* Contribute to securing renewals for expiring contracts by documenting and articulating our value to the customer.
* Participate in engineering efforts required to develop new capabilities to meet customer requirements, document results and sample deliverables.
* Identify sales opportunities and collaborate with Account Executives to grow revenue.
* Process customer self-service sales requests when needed.
* Meet/Exceed SLA targets by driving service management disciplines around incident, change, and problem management.
* Develop content and effectively lead Monthly Service Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other strategic client meetings requested by the customer.
* Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values

* Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements
* Additional duties as assigned

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of professional IT experience with at least 3 years of demonstrated experience related to Enterprise focused TAM role, Solution Architecture and Customer facing Service delivery experience within complex environments.

* Windows Server

* Storage & backup services/administration
* Database; Understanding of data models and data flows in complex multitier database and application environments.
* Unix/Linux
* BCP & DR scenarios/solutions
* Knowledge of Multi-Tier Application architecture design
* Strong interpersonal skills, customer service skills and communication skills
* Problem-solving skills to be able to resolve technical issues.
* Ability to train customers to use systems and software.

:

title: RFX Specialist
description:
Job Title
  
  
RFX Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
**RfX Specialist | Pune | Full-time**
Vanderlande is seeking a proactive Global RfX Specialist to enhance our procurement excellence through robust RfX processes. As part of the global Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE), you will play a pivotal role in supporting our category managers and demand managers worldwide. Your expertise will streamline RfX operations, strengthen supplier communication, and drive process improvements.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables our projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the smart, cost effective, and sustainable procurement of goods and services. We ensure a resilient and competitive supplier ecosystem, supporting our transition towards best-in-class procurement practices and a more efficient, effective, and future proof organization.
  
  
Furthermore, procurement plays an important role in Vanderlande’s transformation from an Engineer to Order (ETO) to a Configure to Order (CTO) business model—enhancing customer value through increased standardization, scalability, and competitiveness.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Global RfX Specialist, you will support all RfX related activities, ensuring the timely and smooth execution of proposals and quotations. You will coordinate submission timelines, assist in evaluating supplier responses, and collaborate closely with cross functional business functions. You will follow established RfX processes while contributing to the continuous improvement of procurement practices across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What you bring**

* Support category managers and demand managers worldwide in executing RfX processes (including spot buys and light tenders), including drafting RfX documents and assisting with initial proposal and quotation analysis.
* Coordinate and communicate submission timelines with suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal stakeholders.
* Consolidate supplier responses into clear, structured formats to support evaluations and decision making.
* Execute all RfX activities in compliance with procurement policies, legal regulations, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Identify opportunities for improving RfX processes and support the implementation of best practices across the Procurement CoE.

**What do we ask from you?**
To be successful in this role, you should have
  
  

* 4-7 years of proven progressive experience in procurement processes and sourcing strategies, ideally with hands on involvement in RfX activities such as drafting documents, evaluating proposals, and supporting supplier selection.
* Experience in project-based procurement environments (e.g., engineering, automation, intralogistics, material handling, or system integration), with the ability to work effectively when requirements evolve or clarity is limited.
* Strong ability to analyze supplier responses, identify key performance indicators, and support strategic procurement decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple RfX tasks simultaneously while maintaining accurate documentation.
* Demonstrated capability to identify and support process improvements, ideally within RfX or procurement operations.
* Stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to work effectively with cross functional global teams such as engineering, project management, category management, finance, and planning.
* Comfort working in ambiguous, low SOP environments, bringing structure, clarity, and proactive follow up when information is incomplete.
* Exposure to global, multicultural environments, with the ability to work across regions, cultures, and time zones.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to interact effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders worldwide.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* 8 sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
  
  
**Diversity & inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Senior Services Architect
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Your primary mission is to ensure that proposed customer engagements are technically sound, accurately estimated, and perfectly aligned with customer zero-trust architectural goals and deployment best practices. Work time is US time.

* Lead technical discovery sessions and deep-dive architecture workshops with enterprise customers to evaluate network architecture, security posture, application catalogs, and migration timelines

* High-trust collaborator, dedicated to collective team success and fostering a culture of open, candid feedback to build enduring trust across sales and delivery organizations.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
* 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (such as Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting) within the cybersecurity or network infrastructure domain
* Deep technical fluency in Zero Trust architecture, including Secure Web Gateways (SWG), SASE/SSE, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), routing, firewalls, and Identity and Access Management (IAM)
* Proven expertise in translating complex technical architectures into defined project phases, tangible deliverables, and precise level-of-effort (LOE) Statement of Work (SOW) scopes

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence platforms or positioning AI-driven security architectures to accelerate complex sales cycles
* Exceptional presentation, whiteboarding, and technical communication skills with a proven track record of engaging both hands-on network engineers and C-level executives (CIOs/CISOs)
* Track record of supporting multiple Service Sales Specialists across concurrent enterprise deals, accompanied by advanced networking or security certifications (such as Zscaler ZCCP-IA/PA or equivalent industry credentials)

Support approximately 50+ Sales Reps across all Medline classes of trade, both domestic and international. Manage multiple ongoing projects, using multiple systems and tools to support sales activities and contribute to the implementation of strategic objectives.

* Partner with Sales to ensure all required information is received in order to begin quoting process including customer, IDN, GPO requirements. Utilize Component Sourcing Specialist and/or contact vendors for pricing, unit of measure, order minimums, and other details needed to provide an accurate costed quote.
* Track and maintain details of all open business priorities, status updates, and due dates from beginning to end. Respond to issues, questions, communicate and align with Sales when timelines and strategy require revision. Ensure turn-times are on track and inform Supervisor if deadlines cannot be met. Provide inputs to regular internal track logs.
* Submit sample requests for components and finished goods. Identify substitutions; request inventory from other locations/sources, communicate and coordinate with needed parties.
* Work with external teams of Sales Reps, Sr. Sales Specialists, Sales Management, Clinical team, IDN team, Customers, and Vendors. Work with other internal teams- Sample Room, Master Data, Project Team, Peri-op Team, Marketing, Supply Chain, Production, Warehouse, Quality, Engineering and other Product Divisions. Partner with internal and external teams to clarify component details for accurate quoting to feed to production. Identify and implement process improvement methods within current and new business processes.
* Responsible for BOM Management and maintenance to ensure business initiatives are implemented to reduce risk and delay to Supply Chain consistency.
* Fulfill ad-hoc custom requests as needed.

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Merchant Cloud and Acceptance represent core strategic priorities for the Asia Pacific region. Our mission is to empower acquirers, merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), and payment facilitators by delivering seamless, best-in-class experiences across both digital and in-person commerce. We aim to position Mastercard Merchant Cloud as the leading platform for acceptance.
  
  
As an integral part of Mastercard’s regional growth strategy, this role will support sales initiatives across Asia Pacific. Key responsibilities include conducting market research and benchmarking, contributing to go-to-market planning, supporting solution commercialization, and engaging in client-related activities. The individual will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Product, Operations, Delivery, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and other internal partners—to drive execution and deliver strategic outcomes.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the identification and assessment of potential opportunities for Merchant Cloud across APAC through data analysis and insight generation.
* Conduct customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify indicators of expansion, cross-sell, or product adoption potential
* Analyze transaction characteristics and market data to support identification of relevant customer segments
* Develop and maintain analytical frameworks and reporting models including opportunity sizing approaches, funnel and conversion analytics, and pipeline coverage metrics for internal monitoring and decision-support purposes.
* Build and maintain integrated analytical datasets and internal insight packs by combining data sources for internal analysis.
* Integrate diverse data inputs to generate analytical insights and structured outputs that may indicate high-potential customers segments and support internal prioritization discussions.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to provide analytical support and validate data assumptions; does not involve participation in commercial decision-making or execution.
* Provide data backed insights, benchmarking and analytical inputs to support value propositions by relevant team, ensuring Mastercard’s differentiation in the Merchant Cloud and Acceptance space.
* Analyse client trends and develop reports and dashboards to provide visibility and support internal decision-making and performance monitoring.
* Partner with internal technology and core payments teams to support pipeline generation through various data sources, reporting and opportunity sizing models.

**All About You**

* Experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce in APAC, ideally with exposure to acquirers, PSPs, merchants, or acceptance ecosystems.
* Strong data analysis capability, including advanced Excel (mandatory) and Tableau or Power BI (preferred).
* Proven ability to work with multi-source datasets and synthesize them into clear, practical outputs.
* Experience supporting multi-market proposition launches, including pipeline dashboards, account-level analysis, and business insights that inform commercial decision-making.
* Ability to translate data into simple, compelling narratives for non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, self-starter mentality, and strong problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and the ability to create structure within a matrix organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Engagement Manager

Bit about us

At Progreva, our mission is to be a leading progressive, values-driven organization that transforms the employee experience, whether in the office, at home or wherever our people choose to work. Our employees’ and contractors’ well-being comes first.

We’re building a culture of camaraderie, work-life balance and empathy, where people feel comfortable, confident and empowered, with the ownership, space and autonomy to succeed.

We believe that when we take great care of our people, they take exceptional care of our clients. That’s why we work only with clients who share our employee-centric values. And yes, we also build breakthrough digital products for our global clients, and have fun along the way!

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Engagement Manager**
to lead Progreva’s engagement with a global energy-technology enterprise, delivered through our European delivery partner. The role has three parts:

·      a
**hands-on consultant**
embedded in the client’s IT organisation

·      a
**trusted advisor**
who helps application owners modernise their systems and grows the account

·      the
**people lead**
for the Progreva engineers on the programme

You will help the client’s application managers put their needs into words, show them what modern technology makes possible, and turn that into well-scoped work for our team. You will also build the same consultative, opportunity-spotting mindset in our engineers.

Responsibilities:

Client-facing Business Analysis

·      Work inside the client’s IT organisation as a
**billable business analyst / application consultant**
, first alongside an experienced Progreva consultant, then on your own.

·      Run
**requirement workshops**
with application managers and users, and turn their needs into user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritised backlogs.

·      Create and maintain
**application documentation**
: functional specs, process flows, architecture overviews, user guides and runbooks.

·      Find
**security and compliance gaps**
(penetration-test findings, access management, outdated components) and coordinate the fixes.

Account Growth & Solutioning

·      Map the client’s applications, understand each product’s users and roadmap, and spot pain points early.

·      Shape
**modernisation opportunities**
: .NET upgrades, cloud migration, UX redesign, test automation and QA, AI automation, data platforms, dashboards and analytics.

·      Turn opportunities into
**scoped proposals**
(problem, solution, estimate, business value), and work with Progreva leadership and our delivery partner to turn them into statements of work.

·      
**Coach engineers**
to spot improvement opportunities in their own products, run regular opportunity reviews, and collect each application’s annual roadmap.

·      Maintain the
**account opportunity pipeline**
and report growth progress to Progreva leadership.

Team Management

·      
**Set clear goals and expectations**
, track individual and team performance, and give regular feedback and support for career development.

·      
**Handle escalations**
as the first point of contact for delivery issues, and own
**account growth**
alongside Progreva leadership.

·      Support
**hiring, onboarding, documentation and knowledge transfer**
, so the team keeps the right skills and continuity across locations.

·      Coordinate plans, timelines, dependencies and status reporting so that commitments are
**delivered on time and to quality**
.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

·      Build long-term relationships with application managers, IT leadership and our delivery partner’s account team.

·      Run regular account and service reviews covering delivery, team health, risks and opportunities.

·      
**Travel to Europe**
when needed (up to 1 month per year) for workshops, planning and partner meetings.

An ideal candidate:

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or IT. An MBA is a plus.

**Skills:**

·      
**6–10 years in IT services**
, including 3+ years in a client-facing BA, consultant, project manager or customer success role, and
**2+ years leading a small team**
.

·      A
**proven track record of growing an account**
by finding, scoping and winning follow-on work.

·      Enough
**technical grounding**
to talk credibly with engineers about software development, cloud, databases, APIs, data/BI and application security. No coding is expected.

·      Strong at
**requirements elicitation and documentation**
, using tools such as Jira/Azure DevOps and Confluence.

·      A
**consultative communicator**
with excellent English, comfortable advising senior business and technical stakeholders without overselling.

·      A natural
**people leader**
who sets clear expectations, gives honest feedback and keeps a distributed team motivated.

·      Familiar with Agile/Scrum. CBAP, SAFe PO/PM, PSM/CSM or PMP is a plus.

·      Experience with
**European clients**
, or in the
**energy, utilities, manufacturing or industrial**
domain, is a strong advantage.

·      Comfortable working
**CET hours**
.

What is in it for you?

·      Helping build an employee-centric, values-driven organization

·      Being part of a growing start-up that is setting new standards for employee well-being while delivering breakthrough digital products

·      Working in an international, distributed environment for industry-leading clients

·      A hybrid setup: 3 days a week at our Baner, Pune office and 2 days from home

·      Working as part of a large client organization, with interesting challenges every day, rather than in an “outsourced model”

·      A competitive salary, a performance-based incentive and a
**healthy work-life balance**

·      A
**visible leadership role**
with direct access to the founder and room to grow as the account grows

How to Apply:

Send your resume and a short cover letter explaining your interest in the
**Engagement Manager**
role to hr@progreva.com. During the interview process you’ll also speak with members of our team to learn about our culture and values. We’ll keep interviewing until we find the right person, so if you’ve read this far, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Water Domain Business Lead
description:
**Job Title**
: Water Domain Business Lead

**Location**
: India (Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Delhi)

**Job Summary**

The Water Domain Business Lead is responsible for building and growing strategic client relationships across the water and wastewater utilities sector. The role combines domain leadership, consultative business development, account planning, solution shaping, and ecosystem collaboration to create qualified demand and convert opportunities into sustainable revenue. The position acts as a trusted business advisor to clients, connects business priorities with TCS capabilities, and orchestrates cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, outcome-led propositions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Achieves Revenue & Pipeline Targets through Demand Creation**

* Identify and develop demand across water and wastewater utilities by connecting client priorities with relevant TCS capabilities, industry solutions, digital engineering, IoT, data, cloud, asset management, operational technology, and transformation services.
* Build and maintain a healthy, qualified opportunity pipeline through executive conversations, account workshops, industry insights, targeted campaigns, partner propositions, and proactive solution concepts.
* Lead opportunity origination and early-stage qualification, establish business value, define the buying context, and shape a clear path from client need to funded initiative.
* Work with sales, accounts, consulting, delivery, solution, and partner teams to improve conversion from lead to qualified opportunity and from opportunity to closure.
* Monitor the pipeline for value, probability, ageing, competitive position, decision milestones, and dependencies, and initiate timely recovery actions where required.

**2 Ownership of Targets**

* Own agreed revenue, order-book, pipeline, and demand-generation targets for the water domain, with clear accountability for performance and forecast accuracy.
* Translate annual business objectives into account-level and solution-level pursuits, measurable milestones, and disciplined execution plans.
* Maintain visibility of target attainment, risks, gaps, and corrective actions, and provide evidence-based updates to leadership.
* Balance short-term pursuit conversion with medium-term pipeline development and long-term strategic account growth.

**3 Positions TCS as Business Advisor**

* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business strategy, operational challenges, regulatory context, investment priorities, technology landscape, and transformation agenda.
* Engage client executives and business leaders with a point of view on sector trends, operational resilience, customer and environmental outcomes, asset performance, data-led decision-making, and digital transformation.
* Create client-specific value propositions, business cases, roadmaps, maturity assessments, and executive narratives that clearly link TCS capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
* Bring relevant TCS experience, reusable assets, alliances, and cross-industry innovation into client discussions without presenting generic or technology-led propositions.
* Build credibility through domain depth, commercial awareness, structured problem solving, and consistent follow-through.

**4 Alliance Led Growth**

* Define and execute alliance-led growth strategies for the water domain by aligning TCS capabilities with complementary technology, engineering, platform, and industry-partner offerings.
* Identify priority alliance partners and jointly develop differentiated propositions, market plays, account-entry strategies, and repeatable solution patterns for water and wastewater utilities.

* Work with alliance, sales, consulting, solution, and delivery teams to originate and qualify partner-influenced opportunities and establish clear ownership across the pursuit lifecycle.
* Develop joint value propositions and business cases that define the client outcome, combined capabilities, delivery responsibilities, commercial model, and competitive differentiation.
* Maintain governance for alliance pursuits, including opportunity tracking, pipeline contribution, partner commitments, solution dependencies, risks, and agreed next actions.
* Strengthen partner relationships through regular business reviews, shared account planning, solution enablement, credential development, and structured knowledge exchange.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, environmental sciences, business, or a related discipline.

A postgraduate qualification in business, management, utilities, or a related field is desirable.

**Experience**

* 10+ experience in the water and wastewater utilities sector, with a strong understanding of utility business, operational, asset, customer, environmental, and regulatory priorities.

* Bachelor's + 9 years, Master's + 7 years of related experience, or equivalent relevant work experience.

* 7+ years of hands-on experience architecting, deploying, and optimizing enterprise-scale Cisco networks.
* Recognized expertise across Cisco SD-Access or Cisco SD-WAN/Meraki and enterprise Routing & Switching (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS/Segment Routing, VXLAN/LISP, multicast, segmentation).

* Candidate might be expected to support PST timezone depending on customer needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCIE certification (Enterprise Infrastructure or equivalent).
* Specialized domain expertise (e.g., Healthcare, BFSI, Public Sector, Service Provider).
* Proven track record of leading multi-million-dollar engagements and complex transformation programs.
* Strong executive communication, mentorship, and thought-leadership skills; experience contributing to industry forums or technical publications.
* Strategic mindset with business and financial acumen to articulate solution value to executive technical buyers.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Microsoft Security Solutions
  
  

* Architect and guide implementation of Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Office 365, and Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Design Microsoft Sentinel SIEM and SOAR solutions, including data onboarding, analytics, automation, workbooks, threat hunting, and incident workflows.
* Design identity security using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management, and identity governance capabilities.
* Design data security and compliance solutions using Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and compliance capabilities.
* Design endpoint and device security capabilities using Microsoft Intune and associated security baselines.
* Define integrations across Microsoft security services, Azure, on-premises platforms, third-party security technologies, and IT service management platforms.

Security Architecture and Consulting
  
  

* Lead cybersecurity architecture assessments, advisory engagements, and transformation programs.
* Design enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles and customer business objectives.
* Develop high-level designs, low-level designs, reference architectures, security roadmaps, and implementation patterns.
* Assess customer security posture and translate security gaps into clear business and technology risks.
* Design identity, endpoint, cloud, network, data protection, and security operations capabilities.
* Advise technical and executive stakeholders on cyber strategy, governance, risk, and compliance.
* Align recommendations with relevant frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and customer regulatory obligations.

Pre-Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support account and sales teams in customer pursuits and strategic opportunities.
* Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, architecture reviews, and solution demonstrations.
* Develop Statements of Work, proposals, solution designs, assumptions, dependencies, effort estimates, and delivery approaches.
* Present proposed architectures and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.
* Identify opportunities for advisory, implementation, optimization, and recurring managed security services.

Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Provide architectural leadership from discovery through design, implementation, transition, and operational acceptance.
* Govern solution quality and confirm that delivery remains aligned with approved architecture and customer requirements.
* Manage technical risks, architectural decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and design exceptions.
* Review customer implementations and recommend improvements that increase security value and reduce risk.
* Mentor consultants, engineers, and junior architects, and contribute to practice capability development.

Service Innovation and Thought Leadership
  
  

* Create reusable reference architectures, delivery accelerators, templates, workshops, and technical enablement materials.
* Contribute field insight to Fujitsu cybersecurity service development and continuous improvement.
* Produce whitepapers, blogs, webinars, executive briefings, and other thought-leadership content.
* Stay current with Microsoft security, cloud infrastructure, AI security, regulatory developments, and industry good practice.

**Required Skills And Experience**
Technical Expertise
  
  
**Identity and Access Management:**
Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, PIM/PAM, identity governance, SSO, and federation.
  
  
**Security Operations:**
Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, SOAR, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, security monitoring, and analytics.
  
  
**Microsoft Defender Suite:**
Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Office 365, and vulnerability management.
  
  
**Cloud and Platform Security:**
Microsoft Azure security, CSPM, workload protection, hybrid security architecture, and integration with third-party platforms.
  
  
**Data Security and Compliance:**
Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, data governance, and compliance management.
  
  
**Architecture and Risk:**
Security principles, enterprise architecture, threat modelling, risk management, control design, and security governance.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
Mandatory
  
  

* 10+ years of cybersecurity experience.
* 5+ years of Microsoft security architecture or engineering experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise security architectures and leading customer-facing consulting engagements.
* Experience developing SOWs, proposals, solution designs, delivery estimates, and technical presentations.
* Ability to communicate security gaps and associated business risks to executives.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, lead multidisciplinary teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within agreed scope.
* Flexibility to support customers remotely and on-site; travel may be required based on engagement needs.

**Preferred**

* Experience in MSSP, MDR, SOC transformation, security advisory, cloud transformation, or global delivery environments.
* Exposure to OT/IoT security, AI security, enterprise architecture, and security service development.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Google Cloud, VMware, and hybrid infrastructure security.
* Experience collaborating with Microsoft sellers, partner teams, and customer technical stakeholders.

Certifications
  
  
Required or Expected
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), or willingness to achieve an agreed Microsoft security certification within six months of joining.
* One or more role-aligned Microsoft certifications such as SC-200, SC-300, AZ-500, or equivalent.

**Preferred**

* CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC, SABSA, TOGAF, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Postgraduate qualification in cybersecurity, technology, or business is advantageous.

Success Measures
  
  

* Customer satisfaction and demonstrable security outcomes.
* Quality, practicality, and governance of security architectures and designs.
* Successful delivery of Microsoft security transformation engagements.
* Contribution to pipeline, proposals, and recurring security services.
* Creation and adoption of reusable intellectual property and delivery accelerators.
* Mentoring, knowledge sharing, and growth of Fujitsu security capability.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Are you a customer-centric professional with a strong technical aptitude and exceptional communication skills, eager to take on the challenges of managing relationships with clients in a dynamic environment? If so, you would want to join our team as a Senior Technical Account Manager to play a crucial role in driving customer success and adoption of Nutanix products, while working in a collaborative, supportive culture alongside experienced professionals dedicated to innovation and excellence.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Senior Technical Account Manager will be joining the APAC iTAM team at Nutanix, which is based in Pune. This team is dedicated to providing exceptional support and service to customers across the APAC region, fostering a strong customer-centric culture characterized by collaboration, transparency, and mutual respect. The mission of the team is to drive customer success and maximize the value of Nutanix products, ensuring that clients realize their full potential and return on investment through proactive engagement and expert guidance.
  
  
You will report to the Manager of Technical Account Management. The work setup for this role is primarily remote, with the expectation that all team members will be based in Pune to cater to the needs of customers across the region.
  
  
For this role, travel is not a primary requirement; however, there may be occasional travel within India based on customer needs for face-to-face meetings. The position primarily involves remote service delivery to customers, maintaining the flexibility to accommodate varying customer preferences.
  
  
Your Role
  
  

* Create a good understanding of the customer’s installed base in terms of licenses consumed/activated, asset refresh opportunities, capacity utilization, software versions, support tickets, features adopted etc.
* Drive increased product adoption, and experience by doing the following:
* Recommend use of features, use cases, and increased capacity utilization by providing insights on usage maturity, and recommending best practices
* Coordinate with Support and Engineering resources to ensure critical support issues are treated with appropriate urgency and visibility
* Identify training needs for the customer and help orchestrate training/boot camps for customers
* Identify the need to upgrade to the latest software versions and support the creation of an upgrade plan for the customer
* Recommend and/or perform health checks, as needed
* Pull in expert Nutanix resources for conducting deeper dives with the customer. Orchestrate the breadth of Nutanix resources (Delivery/Consulting, Support, Architects) as needed

This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. For most roles, that will mean coming into an office a minimum of 2 - 3 days per week, however certain roles and/or teams may require more frequent in-office presence. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
  
  
What You Will Bring
  
  

* 6-10 years of work experience, preferably in technical customer-facing roles (Support engineer, Systems engineer, Technical account manager)
* Strong knowledge of virtualization, cloud computing, and data center technologies (Nutanix Stack preferred)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-centric attitude.
* High technical aptitude with understanding of infrastructure (storage, compute, network).
* Experience working in a customer-facing role, with a focus on account management.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams and manage customer relationships long-term.
* Ability to drive a consultative conversation with the customer
* BE/B.Tech, advanced degree a plus

Work Arrangement
  
  
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

title: Tactical Sourcing IT / ITO
description:
**At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast.**

Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters - bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition.

**Role Purpose**

As a Senior Consultant within the IT Category team, you will lead strategic sourcing initiatives and manage complex procurement activities across a range of IT sub-categories, including Hardware, Software, SaaS, Network, Telecom, and Colocation services. You will partner closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value through cost optimization, commercial excellence, risk management, and innovative sourcing strategies. This role requires strong category expertise, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead high-value sourcing projects in a dynamic global environment.

**Responsibilities**

**Category Strategy & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the subject matter expert for one or more IT procurement sub-categories, including Hardware, Software, SaaS, Network, Telecom, and Colocation services.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across business functions and geographies.
* Build and maintain stakeholder engagement plans and category-specific communication strategies.
* Identify business needs and translate them into sourcing and procurement strategies that support organizational objectives.
* Ensure effective supplier relationship management for strategic and preferred suppliers.

**Sourcing & Procurement Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end sourcing initiatives, including market analysis, supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.
* Conduct spend, contract, and market analyses to identify savings opportunities, efficiencies, and sourcing risks.
* Develop and implement category strategies and sourcing roadmaps aligned with regional and global business requirements.
* Deliver measurable cost savings and value creation through effective sourcing practices.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance standards, and ethical sourcing principles.

**Commercial & Supplier Management**

* Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers to secure optimal contractual, financial, and operational outcomes.
* Manage relationships with major IT vendors and service providers, including global technology partners and specialized providers.
* Support contract reviews and negotiations to ensure commercial robustness and risk mitigation.
* Monitor supplier performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Project & Tender Management**

* Manage multiple sourcing projects simultaneously while ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Design and execute sourcing events, including RFI, RFP, RFQ, and competitive tender processes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to evaluate supplier proposals and support decision-making.
* Track, measure, and report sourcing outcomes and savings achievements.

**Relationship Management**

* Proactively foster effective collaboration and ensure strong communication with key client stakeholders and colleagues in and across the region(s) to deliver defined business goals.
* Develop key client stakeholder matrix per category/location, maintaining regular engagement and driving high levels of client engagement and satisfaction.
* Ensure appropriate supplier relationship management for assigned suppliers.
* Act as key contact person for IT category with expertise on one of sub-categories (HW, SW, SaaS, Network, Telecom, Co-lo) and sourcing initiatives.

**Sourcing Planning**

* Perform spend and contract analysis to identify sourcing and cost reduction opportunities.
* Ability to formulate category specific cost / license / service models such as. for appropriate business needs.
* Working with clients and colleagues, define and implement IT strategies and sourcing area plans for global and regional strategies.

**Management of Sourcing Initiatives**

* Lead and execute IT (HW, SW, SaaS, Network, Telecom, Co-lo) sourcing projects from end-to-end in line with agreed timelines and service quality.
* Deliver allocated savings target as assigned to categories and locations though the effective management of sourcing initiatives, with proper tracking and reporting of savings achievements.
* Adhere to defined sourcing policies and processes.
* Ensure a high-level of ethics in supplier and / or client engagements.

**Requirements**

* University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Law, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
* 5+ years of sourcing, procurement, or category management experience, preferably within IT procurement.
* Strong knowledge of one or more IT procurement categories, including Hardware, Software, SaaS, Cloud, Datacenter, Network, Telecom, and Managed Services.
* Solid understanding of software licensing models, subscription-based services, cloud consumption models, and IT service agreements.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex negotiations and managing commercial contracts with technology suppliers.
* Experience working with major global IT vendors such as IBM, Oracle, Microsoft, SAP, Cisco, Wipro, AWS, Google Cloud, or similar providers.
* Proven project management skills with the ability to manage multiple sourcing initiatives concurrently.
* Hands-on experience conducting RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes and evaluating supplier proposals.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional and international teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Professional sourcing or procurement certifications (e.g., CIPS, CPSM, CSCP, PMP) are advantageous.
* Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

**Join a truly global team.**

We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together.

**Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact.**

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. * Ensure proposals meet defined margin and compliance requirements.

**Solution Design & Cost Estimation**

* Ensure task completion.

**Technical Expertise**

* Demonstrated hands-on experience in Operational Technology (OT) environments, including the design, deployment, and management of industrial automation systems.

* Knowledge in the installation, maintenance, and upgrading of Low Voltage (LV) and Medium Voltage (MV) drives, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
* Knowledge in the after-sales services activities and their offering / proposals like Service and Contract and ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

**Risk & Quality Management**

* Conduct risk assessments and propose mitigation strategies.
* Ensure accuracy in all technical content.
* Collaborate with quality assurance to meet internal standards.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay updated on trends in industrial automation and OT/IT integration.
* Provide feedback for process improvements in the proposal cycle.
* Lead standardization of proposals and tools for network and cybersecurity solutions.

**Success Indicators**

* Deliver accurate, high-quality proposals.
* Proposals align with margin targets, compliance standards and internal processes.
* Support business growth and strategic projects.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Minimum 8 -10 years of experience in proposal/project engineering within industrial automation.
* Technical knowledge of automation technologies (PLCs, DCS, drives, Oils & Gas, after sales Contracts).
* Understanding of cost structures, pricing strategies, and margin analysis is critical.
* You will be asked to use MS office tools

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* Command on contract terms & conditions
* Collaborative mindset.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
* adaptable communication style.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with senior partners.

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
