title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300057
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 Experience: 12\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Manager – Donor Relations Management
description:
**Company Overview:** 
 Bharatiya Jain Sanghatana is a non\-profit organisation dedicated to nation\-building through impactful social development, disaster response, environmental stewardship, and educational initiatives since 1985\. With a strong nationwide presence and an active volunteer network, BJS works collaboratively with governments, communities and partners to design and implement sustainable solutions to pressing societal challenges. The organization’s mission is to identify relevant social concerns, develop meaningful interventions and ensure their effective, scalable implementation across the country.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 
 The Manager – Donor Relations Management will play a crucial role in strengthening and expanding strategic partnerships with corporates, CSR foundations, philanthropic institutions and other relevant stakeholders to support BJS’ mission and programmes. The role combines strategic engagement, relationship management, proposal development, impact communication and effective coordination across functions to drive resource mobilization and deepen partner engagement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**(a) Partnership Strategy \& Outreach:** 




  Research, identify and engage potential partners whose priorities align with BJS’ mission, programmes and impact goals.
 



  Support development of tailored engagement strategies for prospective donors.
 



  Assist in developing high\-quality concept notes, proposals, partnership decks and budgets for effective donor engagement.
 



**(b) Donor Engagement \& Relationship Management:** 




  Build and nurture long\-term relationships with existing and prospective donor partners.
 



  Coordinate meetings, presentations and follow\-up conversations with all stakeholders to progress partnership engagements.
 



  Work with programme teams to capture impact data, success stories and case studies for donor engagement and reporting purposes.
 



  Support programme teams in developing proposals, concept notes, and strategic project documentation.
 



**(c) Donor Reporting \& Compliance:** 




  Prepare high\-quality, timely and accurate donor reports (monthly, quarterly, annual) as per agreed formats and timelines with various donor partners.
 



  Coordinate with programme and finance teams to collect utilization data, impact metrics and supporting documentation.
 



  Ensure compliance with donor agreements, MoUs and CSR reporting requirements.
 



  Closely track grant milestones, deliverables and utilisation schedules to avoid delays and non\-compliance.
 



  Maintain complete documentation of agreements, amendments, invoices and reporting records related to all donor/partner engagements.
 



**(d) Donor Database \& Systems Management:** 




  Maintain and regularly update donor databases, CRM systems, and grant trackers.
 



  Monitor key donor timelines, renewal cycles and reporting calendars.
 



  Develop structured trackers for grant utilization and partnership commitments.
 



**(e) Partner and Stakeholder Engagement:** 




  Serve as a bridge between partners, programme and finance teams to ensure execution of donor commitments.
 



  Support the leadership/management with data, summaries and briefing notes for various donor engagements.
 



  Assist in developing donor engagement SOPs and internal reporting systems.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 




  





  Master’s degree in development studies, Social Work, Management, or a related field.
 



  Minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in donor management, CSR partnerships, grant management or institutional fundraising within the social development/non\-profit sector.
 



  Understanding of CSR compliance frameworks and grant management processes.
 



  





**Key Skills and Competencies:** 




  





  Excellent verbal and written communication abilities in English and Hindi. Working knowledge of Marathi a plus.
 



  Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (for grant tracking, utilisation analysis) and PowerPoint (for donor presentations).
 



  Ability to manage multiple donor accounts simultaneously with structured planning.
 



  High level of integrity, empathy, and alignment with service\-oriented values.

title: Field Application Engineer ;West India
description:

Our products are widely used in Automotive, Industrial, Consumer, Computing, and Communications applications. We are committed to providing innovative analog solutions that improve system performance, reduce energy consumption, and accelerate time\-to\-market for our customers.

 We are seeking an experienced, high\-performing
 **Field Applications Engineer (FAE)** 
 to cover our
 **West Region** 
 . In this technical customer\-facing role, you will be responsible for driving technical design\-ins and design\-wins, focusing primarily on the
 **Automotive** 
 and
 **Industrial** 
 segments, alongside other key market verticals aligned with Silergy’s product portfolio.
 



 You will act as the technical bridge between our customers, sales team, and global R\&D engineers, providing system\-level design support, troubleshooting, and product recommendations.

* **Design\-In \& Design\-Win Execution:** 
 Drive technical engagement with customers across the West region to secure Silergy analog and power management IC design wins in Automotive, Industrial, and targeted commercial applications.

* **Customer Relationship Management:** 
 Build and maintain strong technical relationships with customer engineering teams, system architects, and technical decision\-makers.
* **Product Promotion \& Training:** 
 Present Silergy’s product line, solution roadmaps, and technical advantages to potential and existing customers through workshops, seminars, and technical reviews.
* **Market \& Technical Intelligence:** 
 Gather customer requirement trends, competitor analysis, and market insights from the West region to provide feedback to internal R\&D and Product Line Managers for future product definition.
* **Collaborative Sales Drive:** 
 Partner closely with the Sales team and Distribution partners to identify new business opportunities and achieve revenue growth targets.



**Qualifications \& Key Requirements** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:** 
 4 to 8\+ years of hands\-on experience as an FAE, Hardware Design Engineer, or Application Engineer in the semiconductor industry.
* **Segment Expertise:** 
 Deep domain knowledge in
 **Automotive** 
 (EV/HEV, ADAS, BMS, Body Electronics, Lighting) and/or
 **Industrial** 
 ( Renewable Energy, Motor Control, Power Supplies),
 **Consumer, Telecom**
* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong expertise in Analog \& Power Management ICs (DC/DC converters, LDOs, Gate Drivers, PMICs, Battery Management, Sensor Interfaces, etc.).
* Hands\-on skills with PCB design, schematic capture, circuit simulation, and laboratory testing equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads).
* Knowledge of Automotive functional safety standards (ISO 26262\) and AEC\-Q qualifications is a strong plus.
* **Soft Skills:** 
 Excellent technical communication, presentation, and problem\-solving skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
* **Mobility:** 
 Willingness to travel within the West region as required for customer visits and technical workshops.


**Why Join Silergy?** 
* **Growth Opportunity:** 
 Be a key player in expanding Silergy's presence in high\-growth segments (Automotive \& Industrial).
* **Innovative Culture:** 
 Work alongside world\-class engineers with cutting\-edge analog technology.
* **Competitive Package:** 
 Attractive salary, performance bonuses, and career advancement opportunities.

**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation —from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.** 
**The team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop the appropriate business models, technology operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future technology strategies

**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (Consumer)**

* Technology Strategy \& Alignment – Delivering Technology Strategy, driven both from a top\-down analysis starting with an articulated business strategy and a bottom\-up technology capability analysis; Experience working on cost reduction techniques, portfolio modernization and delivery roadmap creation within Consumer Industry
* Cloud Strategy – Understand the impact of cloud computing through hybrid cloud, data centers, cloud strategy in business and technology decisions, ability to identify and articulate the business and technology drivers of cloud computing across industries, design of business cases for cloud. Certifications such as AWS, GCP, Azure will be a plus. Experience with workload assessment, business cases development, operational assessment, roadmap creation, vendor selection for companies in Consumer space
* Technology Operating Model Design \- Assessment of current state operating model, ability to identify pain points and process gaps; design of target state operating model and associated roadmap for leading companies in Consumer Industry
* Enterprise Architecture – Experience of Enterprise Architecture capabilities such as Blueprinting, solution architecture, architecture assessment, planning and cost estimation. Knowledge of any of the major Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (preferred) E.g., TOGAF, FEA(F), and DoDAF.
* Technology Outsourcing \- Experience working on Technology Outsourcing model, vendor analysis and benchmarking, contract analysis and understanding of how IT resources create shareholder (business) value within Consumer Industry
* AI/ML – Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and frameworks, ability to design solutions around automation including advanced AI / ML solutions in areas of deep learning, machine learning, NLP, Simulation etc.; knowledge of AI/ML implementation use cases within Consumer Industry
* GenAI – Knowledge and experience in GenAI concepts, landscape (E.g., OpenAI, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, NVIDIA AI Foundations, GPT3 etc.) use cases across relevant industries and ability to assess GenAI fitment based on client demands within Consumer Industry
* DevOps / Agile – Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering with hands on experience on tools such as Jenkins, Git and JIRA
* Strong understanding of front\-to\-back architecture principles, technology stack, infrastructure with exposure to new age tools
* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing Technology strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology implications within Consumer Industry
* Demonstrate application of business acumen while leveraging information technology
* Exposure to working in non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders


**Core Consulting**
* Communication: Ability to conduct client interviews, facilitate workshops and training sessions, and present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely
* Client Presence: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and cross\-functional team members
* Analytical Thinking: Proficiency in quantitative analysis, primary and secondary research, and business case development; ability to synthesize data into actionable insights and recommendations. Strong command of analytical and productivity tools including Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (storyboarding, executive\-level presentations) is a plus
* Structured Problem Solving: Logical, hypothesis\-driven approach to problem solving with demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis
* Delivery Excellence: Deadline\-oriented and quality\-focused; capable of owning end\-to\-end delivery of high\-quality work products, managing workstreams, developing engagement plans, and mentoring junior team members
* Collaboration: Comfortable working independently and within teams across all levels; able to prioritize effectively, manage scope changes, handle multiple assignments simultaneously, and escalate issues proactively
* Networking: Self\-starter with the ability to navigate career growth and build a strong internal and external professional network

title: Territory head
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mintifi is a technology\-led growth financing platform that powers India’s SME ecosystem by improving access to capital for businesses at every stage of growth. For nearly a decade, the company has supported SME enterprises, manufacturers, distributors, dealers, retailers, and exporters across India with tailored financing solutions. Its offerings include supply chain, dealer and vendor, equipment, solar, export, and working capital financing, as well as loan against property, helping businesses strengthen cash flow and expand capacity. Mintifi combines deep industry expertise with advanced technology to deliver faster, simpler, and more efficient credit experiences, backed by a strong network of enterprises, financial institutions, and channel partners. Since 2017, Mintifi has been redefining business financing in India and is supported by leading global investors while staying focused on making growth capital more accessible and aligned with the ambitions of Indian businesses.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Territory Head role at Mintifi is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Pune District, responsible for driving business growth and managing the overall performance of the territory. The role involves identifying and onboarding new partners and clients, deepening relationships with existing accounts, and ensuring consistent achievement of sales and portfolio quality targets. The Territory Head will oversee local operations, coordinate with internal teams for credit, risk, and collections, and ensure smooth execution of financing solutions across channels. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include market mapping, pipeline management, performance tracking, and reporting, as well as coaching and supporting the territory team to meet business objectives. The role also requires monitoring competitor activity, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines, and representing Mintifi in local business communities.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong background in sales and business development within financial services, SME lending, or related domains, with proven experience in managing territories or regions.
* Solid understanding of credit, risk, and portfolio management concepts, including the ability to interpret financial statements and assess business viability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills, with experience working with SMEs, distributors, dealers, and channel partners.
* Effective leadership and team management capabilities, including mentoring, performance tracking, and driving results through cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills, with proficiency in using CRM tools, data dashboards, and productivity software.
* Clear and confident communication skills in English and local languages, with the ability to present, negotiate, and influence at multiple levels.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment and adapt to evolving business needs and processes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification (MBA or equivalent) is preferred.

 We are looking for a
 **Director \- Solution Architecture** 
 to lead the architecture and delivery of complex healthcare technology solutions for strategic enterprise clients across the United States. This is a senior, client\-facing leadership role focused on designing scalable solutions, driving complex implementations, translating business and regulatory requirements into technology capabilities, and ensuring successful enterprise adoption.
   

  

 The role will work closely with senior client stakeholders, product, engineering, implementation, operations, and commercial teams. You will own solution architecture across the full lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through implementation, go\-live, optimization, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare domain expertise with enterprise architecture, implementation leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex operational requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Enterprise Solution Architecture**
* Own solution architecture for a portfolio of strategic enterprise healthcare accounts from initial discovery through implementation and steady state
* Understand complex client workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, regulatory requirements, and technology environments
* Design scalable, secure, and configurable solutions that address multi\-site, multi\-state, and multi\-payer requirements
* Translate business and operational requirements into detailed solution architectures, workflows, integrations, configurations, and implementation plans
* Serve as the senior architectural counterpart to client technology, operations, finance, and business leadership
* Ensure solutions align with product capabilities, technical standards, security requirements, and long\-term scalability


**Solution Design \& Implementation**
* Lead architecture and solution design for complex enterprise implementations involving multiple locations, states, payers, workflows, and system integrations
* Define system configuration, integration dependencies, data flows, workflows, and implementation sequencing
* Work with implementation and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions are translated accurately into production\-ready solutions
* Identify implementation risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and opportunities for standardization early in the lifecycle
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, configuration templates, solution frameworks, and implementation playbooks
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying recurring implementation challenges and addressing them at the platform or architecture level


**Healthcare Revenue Cycle \& Domain Architecture**
* Apply strong knowledge of US healthcare revenue cycle processes to solution design, particularly outpatient and professional billing environments
* Translate requirements related to payer rules, claims processing, denials, eligibility, payment posting, reimbursement, and revenue cycle workflows into scalable technology solutions
* Understand healthcare transactions and standards including 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, EDI, ERA, and payer enrollment
* Incorporate requirements related to CMS\-1500, UB\-04, claim edits, NCCI logic, modifiers, therapy\-specific billing rules, claim scrubbing, remit reconciliation, and payment workflows
* Evaluate regulatory and payer changes and assess their implications for product architecture, integrations, and solution design
* Identify recurring operational or billing issues and work with product and engineering teams to address root causes through platform capabilities rather than manual intervention


**Enterprise Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting**
* Act as the senior solution architecture expert during enterprise sales pursuits, RFPs, discovery sessions, technical evaluations, and client presentations
* Lead solution discovery with prospective clients to understand business, operational, technical, and integration requirements
* Define what can realistically be delivered within existing product and technical capabilities and identify areas requiring customization or product enhancement
* Develop solution proposals, architecture approaches, implementation assumptions, integration strategies, and technical responses for enterprise opportunities
* Partner with sales and commercial teams to ensure technical commitments are accurate, achievable, and clearly documented
* Ensure requirements are captured effectively and handed over to implementation teams without unnecessary re\-discovery or ambiguity


**Product \& Technology Strategy**
* Translate enterprise customer requirements into actionable product and engineering requirements
* Partner with product leadership to influence roadmap priorities based on recurring customer needs, market requirements, and healthcare industry changes
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, configurability, automation, interoperability, and operational efficiency

title: Senior Platform Architect-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Platform Architect\-1
   

  

**Overview**
 Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in\-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
   

  

 This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
   

  

 This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
   

  

 Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
   

  

 Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
   

  

 Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
   

  

 Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.


**All About You**
* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high\-energy, proactive, detail\-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self\-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro\-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments


**Skills/Abilities**
* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on\-the\-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross\-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking a professional with deep expertise in competitive pricing, commercial strategy, and market intelligence to support profitable business growth across VOIS. This role focuses on shaping pricing strategy, developing rate cards, designing commercial models, and enabling informed decision\-making through high\-quality analysis and benchmarks.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Shape and execute market pricing strategy by partnering with senior leadership to support sustainable and profitable growth
* Develop deal\-specific pricing strategies by analysing competitor positioning, internal capabilities, and market benchmarks
* Design and maintain rate cards that reflect market dynamics and support consistent pricing across geographies
* Structure, review, and enhance cost models to ensure competitiveness, fiscal discipline, and alignment with long\-term business goals
* Lead and guide the Pricing Support team in creating effective commercial proposals for bids and client engagements
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, HR, Marketing, and service delivery teams to ensure alignment on commercial decisions and customer needs
* Analyse programme metrics, monitor yearly targets, and support reporting for leadership reviews


**Who You Are**
* Experienced in competitive analysis, market intelligence, pricing strategy, and commercial optimisation
* Skilled in advanced Excel with the ability to handle complex data models, pricing sheets, and scenario analysis
* Possesses a strong accounting background with exposure to commercial functions within services or SaaS environments
* Capable of influencing senior stakeholders and communicating insights with clarity and impact
* Demonstrates strong problem\-solving skills, collaboration, and a continuous\-improvement mindset


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunities to contribute to pricing strategy and commercial decision\-making across global markets
* Exposure to senior leadership, cross\-functional stakeholders, and high\-impact commercial programmes
* A collaborative environment that values innovation, data\-driven thinking, and strategic problem\-solving
* Ability to influence business growth and shape VOIS’ competitive positioning


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced commercial modelling and pricing strategy development
* Cross\-functional collaboration in a global enterprise environment
* Strategic thinking related to market intelligence and deal shaping
* Executive communication and influencing skills through high\-stakes commercial engagements
